description:

Your wallet is your agent

- Move the wallet and the agent moves with you. The device is replaceable. The wallet is the agent.

On-device agents
- Coding agents like Claude and Codex run whole inside an isolated Linux environment on your phone.
- There is no cloud server, so your keys and sessions stay on the device by default.

On-chain skill market
- Publish what your agent does well and it becomes a soulbound Token-2022 item on Solana.
- When someone buys your skill, the SOL goes to you, the creator.
- A purchased skill is not a collectible. It equips to your agent and works immediately.
- Profiles, reputation, and reviews tell you which agents and skills to trust.

Sessions follow the wallet
- Back up encrypted sessions to your own Google Drive, sign in with the same wallet on another device, and pick up exactly where you left off.

Notes
- This app uses real SOL on Solana mainnet. Buying and publishing skills are real on-chain transactions with network fees. Start small.
- This is an early access build with rough edges. Feedback is welcome.

name: Flashback AI [BETA]
description:
Flashback is a Privacy-First AI memory app that listens to your life stories as you share them in audio chats with our voice assistant, and Flashback turns them into structured Memory Orbs you can own, verify, and control without surrendering your personal data to ad-driven platforms.

You talk; Flashback organizes memories around people, time, and emotion, and preserves them as a private archive designed to train your future AI twins.

⸻

How it works

• Tap the mic & talk
Share a moment from today, a childhood story, a call with your mom, or something you don’t want to lose. No typing. Your data stays private and tied to your identity, not a public profile.

• AI extracts the “Flashbacks.”
Flashback detects the moments that matter, who they were about, what happened, when/where, and why it mattered then saves them as structured memories in your private timeline.

• Memories become Memory Orbs
Each moment becomes a Memory Orb: an emotion-rich capsule containing story, metadata, and relationships. Orbs are private by default and designed to feel like a safe vault, not a feed.

⸻

What are Memory Orbs?

Memory Orbs are living containers for your life:
	•	A story + context of a real moment
	•	Linked to the people in your life
	•	Organized by time, emotion, and relationships
	•	Stored in one private place you control anytime access

No public timeline. No engagement farming. No ad incentives.

⸻

Why Web3 users care

• Ownership, not platforms
Your memories aren’t “content” for someone else’s business model. Flashback is built around a user-owned data ethos.

• Transparency & consent
You can see what’s being processed, what’s stored, and what stays private. No silent data extraction.

• A foundation for future AI twins
Every Memory Orb becomes part of a growing personal dataset that can later power your AI twin trained from your own memories and relationships.

• Monetization on your terms (optional)
If you ever choose to share or license outputs, it’s designed to be opt-in, auditable, and aligned with creator ownership, not “free training data.”

⸻

Privacy, by default
	•	Private by default: no discover feed, no public timeline
	•	Control: edit/delete or export your orbs and recordings
	•	No ad profiling: your memories aren’t used to build ad graphs
	•	Secure processing: built to treat memories as sensitive data

⸻

Who it’s for
	•	Web3 natives who want user-owned personal data
	•	Parents and adult children preserving family stories
	•	Anyone who prefers speaking over journaling
	•	People building a private archive that can later train an AI twin
shortDescription: Capture Your Life Moments to Train Future AI Twins

• Create from a selfie. One frontal photo (two optional side angles sharpen the likeness) becomes a textured, rigged, animation-ready avatar in about a minute. No photo? Describe the character in text, or upload a GLB you already have.

• Embed anywhere. Every agent has a shareable URL and a one-line embed snippet for Telegram, X, or your own site.
• Sign with Seed Vault. Wallet linking, transaction approval, and Sign-In With Solana all route through Mobile Wallet Adapter. No seed phrases, no browser extensions.

WHY SEEKER

three.ws talks to the Seeker's on-device wallet through the Mobile Wallet Adapter protocol, so signing lives inside the hardware-isolated secure element and sign-in is a single tap. The agents you create on Seeker show up on the three.ws web app the moment you sign in there: your wallet, your library, anywhere you sign in.

OPEN BY DEFAULT

three.ws is open source (github.com/nirholas/three.ws). Agents are Metaplex Core assets on Solana with an open manifest, so they are portable to any compatible marketplace or wallet. No vendor lock-in.

REQUIREMENTS

• A Solana wallet: Seed Vault on Seeker or Saga.
• Camera permission (only for selfie capture; you can upload a photo instead).
• A small amount of SOL to deploy an agent on-chain (typically under 0.01 SOL). Creating, chatting, and browsing are free.

SUPPORT

Questions, bug reports, or feature requests: support@three.ws · https://three.ws/docs · github.com/nirholas/three.ws/issues

## Weekly Rewards System

The platform includes an automated weekly rewards system that distributes SMP tokens to users based on their activity points. 

Every Sunday at midnight UTC, 21,000,000 SMP tokens are distributed proportionally to users based on their accumulated weekly points.

### How It Works

1. Users earn weekly points through platform activity
2. Points are tracked in the `weekly_points` field of the users table
3. The weekly rewards function runs automatically every Sunday
4. 21,000,000 SMP tokens are distributed proportionally to users with points
5. Tokens are added to users' off-chain wallet balances
6. Weekly points are reset after distribution
7. Users can withdraw their SMP tokens through the Novels page

WHAT YOU CAN HOLD
• Tokenized U.S. equities — NVIDIA, Apple, Tesla, Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Meta, Coinbase, MicroStrategy, Netflix, AMD (xStocks issued by Backed Finance under Liechtenstein blockchain-asset law, with underlying shares held in licensed Swiss custody)
• Major indices — S&P 500 (SPYx, VOOx), NASDAQ-100 (QQQx)
• Commodities — Gold (GLDo), Silver (SLVx), Oil (USOx)
• U.S. Treasuries — TLT (TLTo), short-term government debt (Ondo Finance)

ON-CHAIN SETTLEMENT
Every transaction settles on the Solana blockchain through publicly auditable smart contracts. There is no central order book, no Lume-operated counterparty, and no broker holding your assets. Your non-custodial wallet signs each transaction and the swap routes through open-source decentralized aggregator protocols (such as Jupiter) to non-custodial liquidity. Tap "Verify ↗" on any transaction to view it on Solscan.

FUND IN YOUR LOCAL CURRENCY
Convert local currency to USDC through Onramper Technologies B.V., an EU-regulated technology aggregator (Netherlands Chamber of Commerce 76602877) that exposes a curated set of independently-licensed Fiat Gateways. Available rails include UPI (India), AED card and bank transfer (UAE), naira bank transfers (Nigeria), credit and debit cards, and SEPA — together covering 27 jurisdictions including Australia, Brazil, Canada, the European Union, India, Indonesia, the Philippines, Switzerland, Turkey, the United Arab Emirates, and the United Kingdom.

Licensed providers include MoonPay, Banxa, BTCDirect, Coinify, Onmeta, onramp.money, Revolut, Sardine, Transak, and Uphold — supervised by FCA, DNB, FinCEN, AUSTRAC, FINTRAC, the Bank of Lithuania, the Estonian Financial Intelligence Unit, the Liechtenstein FMA, FIU-IND, BAPPEBTI, VARA, and other competent regulators.

NON-CUSTODIAL BY DESIGN
Your wallet, your keys, your assets. Authentication is provided by Privy. Lume does not custody funds, hold private keys in any recoverable form, or take possession of your tokens. Every asset visible in the app lives on-chain in your own Solana wallet — not on Lume's balance sheet.

WHAT LUME IS NOT
Lume is a software interface, not a broker, exchange, money services business, or money transmitter. We do not match buyers and sellers, do not custody funds, do not convert fiat currencies, do not set exchange rates, and do not provide investment, legal, or tax advice. Tokenized assets are issued by independent third parties (Backed Finance, Ondo Finance) under their respective regulatory regimes. Fiat conversion is provided exclusively by independently-licensed Fiat Gateways aggregated through Onramper.

GEOGRAPHIC AVAILABILITY
The app is available in App Store storefronts where one or more Onramper Fiat Gateways are appropriately licensed. United States residents and residents of comprehensively-sanctioned jurisdictions are not eligible. The on-ramp automatically restricts available providers based on user location.

name: Predikt
description:
Predikt turns prediction market positions into usable collateral. Instead of sitting idle until resolution, users can borrow against their positions, add leverage to double down on their convictions, or earn yield rather than leaving capital locked in a binary bet.

Prediction markets today are fragmented across platforms, liquidity pools, wallets, and chains. Users must manually move capital between isolated markets while liquidity remains siloed and inefficient.

At the same time, millions in prediction market positions remain locked and idle until market resolution, limiting capital efficiency and preventing broader integration with DeFi applications.

Predikt aggregates liquidity, execution, and positions across prediction market platforms into a unified protocol layer that simplifies access to prediction markets and optimizes execution across venues.

The protocol enables users to access the best pricing, liquidity, and arbitrage opportunities through a single interface while abstracting away fragmented infrastructure and cross-platform complexity.

It enables prediction market exposure to function as liquid on-chain collateral, allowing positions to be integrated into trading, lending, and yield strategies throughout the Solana ecosystem instead of remaining isolated and idle.
shortDescription: Turn idle prediction positions into liquid assets.

name: RangeKeeper
description:
Most liquidity positions on Meteora are quietly earning nothing. We scanned every funded position on three major pools: 81% of 6,678 were sitting out of range, collecting zero fees while fully exposed to one token. Most owners had no idea.

CHECK ANY WALLET, FREE
Paste an address and see every open DLMM position: in range or not, real PnL by Meteora's own accounting, and where the price sits against your bounds. It runs entirely on your phone, reading Meteora's public API directly — no wallet connect, no signup, and your address is never sent to us.

A TRACK RECORD THAT SHOWS ITS LOSSES
We run the same engine on our own money, in public. Every number is measured against simply holding the same tokens — never fee APR. The lanes our circuit breaker closed at a loss stay on the board, because roughly half of all LPs underperform holding and we would rather measure that honestly than sell around it.

24/7 ALERTS (OPTIONAL)
Get told the moment a position goes out of range, nears a bound, or falls behind holding. Free for one wallet. Pro is a flat $19/month in USDC for ten — we never take a percentage of your yield.

YOUR KEYS NEVER MOVE
RangeKeeper is read-only. It never asks for a key or seed phrase and cannot touch your funds.

Providing concentrated liquidity can and does lose money, including versus simply holding. Nothing here is financial advice.

name: RetireOnSol
description:
RetireOnSol is a native Solana retirement planning app built for Seeker. It offers two modes: a simple Basic mode for quick projections, and a deep Advanced mode with four dedicated tabs for complete retirement planning.

BASIC MODE: Enter your current SOL holdings, monthly DCA amount, years until retirement, and desired monthly income. Get instant portfolio projections with Monte Carlo simulations, pessimistic/median/optimistic outcomes, total ROI, and a sustainability verdict telling you exactly how long your retirement income will last.

ADVANCED MODE — GROW TAB: Choose from four growth models (CAGR with auto-decay, Power Law regression, S-Curve adoption, and Rainbow bands). Run 500-path Monte Carlo simulations with configurable percentile ranges. Set DCA frequency (daily, weekly, monthly, yearly) with custom investment amounts. Compare all models side-by-side on a single chart. View year-by-year breakdowns of SOL accumulated, price projections, and portfolio value in both nominal and inflation-adjusted terms.

ADVANCED MODE — SPEND TAB: Simulate retirement drawdowns using your Grow results. Set monthly income needs, see success probability across hundreds of Monte Carlo paths. View which scenarios fail and when, with detailed failed-path analysis. Median ending balance and years of sustainable income.

ADVANCED MODE — MONITOR TAB: Execute your plan and track it in real time. View your DCA schedule with next purchase dates. See funding progress, total invested vs target. Connect your Seed Vault wallet via native MWA to import live SOL balance. Get push notifications for DCA reminders and SOL price alerts.

ADVANCED MODE — LEADERBOARD TAB: Compete with other Seeker users. Scores auto-submit every hour based on plan commitment, DCA streak, and activity. Identified by your .skr Seeker ID — no registration or auth tokens required.

WALLET: Connect via Seed Vault using native Mobile Wallet Adapter (MWA). Wallet connection persists across app restarts. Import your live SOL balance directly into projections.

ADDITIONAL FEATURES: Editable slider values (tap any number to type exact amounts). Live SOL price with auto-refresh. JitoSOL staking yield factored into returns. Inflation-adjusted projections (configurable rate). Shareable projection images. Biometric lock (fingerprint/face) for privacy. Push notifications for DCA reminders and price alerts. Dark theme optimized for OLED.

name: GoatNode
description:
GoatNode is a Seeker-native DePIN built on Solana Mobile. It is the first app to turn your $SKR stake on the Solana Mobile Guardian pool directly into in-game fuel, meaning every SKR you have staked on your Seeker device through the official Guardian pool is not just sitting idle — it is actively powering your daily progression inside GoatNode.

How the Stake-to-Fuel System Works
GoatNode reads your live $SKR stake from the Solana blockchain in real time. Specifically, it reads from the official Solana Mobile Guardian pool staking program (program ID: SKRskrmtL83pcL4YqLWt6iPefDqwXQWHSw9S9vz94BZ) and the Guardian pool account (DPJ58trLsF9yPrBa2pk6UaRkvqW8hWUYjawe788WBuqr). Every $SKR you have staked on your Solana Mobile Guardian is converted at a 1:1 ratio into fuel for the next UTC day. If you have staked 1,000 $SKR in the Guardian pool today, you will receive 1,000 fuel units to spend tomorrow. This conversion happens automatically at 00:00 UTC every day through GoatNode's on-chain snapshot system. Your stake is verified live — nothing is assumed, and no manual bridging or token wrapping is required. You simply stake $SKR through your Seeker device as you normally would, and GoatNode reads and converts it for you.

Streak Multiplier
Consistent daily participation is rewarded. Every day you actively consume your fuel before the UTC reset, your streak counter increases. Your streak applies a multiplier to your fuel conversion rate: starting at 1.01x on day one and growing by 0.01x per consecutive active day, capping at a 1.10x multiplier on day 10 and beyond. A player with 1,000 $SKR staked and a 10-day streak receives 1,100 fuel instead of 1,000. Skipping a day resets your streak, so daily participation is the core discipline GoatNode is built around.

Feeding the Goat
Once your daily fuel is loaded, you spend it by tapping your goat on the Feed screen. Each tap consumes fuel based on your current Tap Power level and awards XP and Goat Points in return. The feed cycle operates in structured windows: every three-hour cycle contains one active hour where you can tap freely, followed by a two-hour cooldown. During the active window you can feed your goat repeatedly until your fuel runs out or the window closes. You cannot feed during cooldown. Each day contains eight feed cycles, so there are eight opportunities per day to spend fuel and accumulate progression. The day is also subject to a global daily fuel cap of 1,000,000 units shared across all players — when the global pool is depleted, no further feeding is possible until the next UTC reset.

NFTs: GoatNode Genesis Pod
GoatNode's NFT collection is called GoatNode Genesis Pod, with a maximum supply of 9,999 NFTs minted at 5,000 $SKR each through a Candy Machine. NFTs are not cosmetic. They are functional, and they change how the game plays for you in three concrete ways. First, you must own and lock a GoatNode Genesis NFT to farmland before you can feed at all — NFT ownership is the gate to participation. Second, holding multiple NFTs reduces your feed cooldown. With one NFT your cooldown is two hours. Each additional NFT reduces that cooldown by six minutes and forty seconds, down to a minimum of one hour at ten NFTs — meaning players with the maximum ten NFTs get twice as many feeding opportunities per day as players with one NFT. Third, your Goat Points gain per feed scales with the number of NFTs you hold (counted up to a cap of ten), amplifying your competitive output on the leaderboard the more NFTs you control. After you mint your NFT, you lock it to the farmland wallet through the Lock page inside GoatNode. Once locked, your NFT activates at the next UTC day boundary and your feed access opens.

XP and Tier Progression
Your XP is accumulated through feeding and determines your tier. Tiers are permanent progression milestones: Baby (0 to 4,999 XP), Worker (5,000 to 24,999 XP), and Alpha (25,000+ XP). Each feed tap awards XP using the formula: 0.01 × fuel spent × streak multiplier. At the base tap power of x1 with no streak bonus, that is 0.01 XP per tap. At tap power x10 with a ten-day streak, that is 0.11 XP per tap. Your tier is visible on the leaderboard and reflected in your NFT metadata — tier promotions trigger live on-chain metadata updates to your GoatNode Genesis Pod NFT.

Goat Points and the Leaderboard
Goat Points are a separate track from XP and are what determine your leaderboard ranking. They accumulate via the formula: floor(0.01 × fuel spent × NFT count × streak multiplier). This means Goat Points reward the combination of staking more $SKR (more fuel), holding more NFTs (NFT count multiplier), and maintaining a streak (streak multiplier). The global leaderboard ranks players by Goat Points first, with XP and streak depth as tiebreakers. Your .skr domain name from Solana Mobile resolves automatically as your in-app identity on the leaderboard.

Tap Power Marketplace
Your base tap power starts at x1, meaning each tap consumes one fuel unit. You can upgrade your tap power up to a maximum of x10 by purchasing upgrades through GoatNode's on-chain marketplace. Upgrades are sequential — you must buy x2 before x3, and so on. Each level costs double the previous: x2 costs 300 $SKR, x3 costs 600 $SKR, x4 costs 1,200 $SKR, and so on up to x10. Payment goes directly to the treasury wallet on-chain and is verified by GoatNode before the upgrade is credited. Higher tap power lets you consume more fuel per tap, accumulate XP and Goat Points faster per active window, and extract more value from each feed cycle — but it also means your fuel runs out faster, so managing stake size and tap power relative to your daily fuel budget is a real strategic consideration.

DePIN Telemetry
Every feed tap you make on your Seeker device captures real-world network telemetry and submits it to GoatNode's DePIN data layer. This includes your GPS coordinates and accuracy, network type (WiFi, 4G LTE, 5G, cellular), effective connection type, downlink speed in Mbps, connection round-trip time in milliseconds, and Bluetooth availability. This telemetry is aggregated into a live geospatial heatmap of mobile network quality data that GoatNode exposes to enterprise data buyers and carriers through an authenticated B2B API with quota-based access controls and export in CSV and GeoJSON formats. Your participation in the feed loop is simultaneously powering real network intelligence — this is the DePIN value loop that GoatNode is built on. You can view your own personal tap telemetry at any time through the Node Activity page inside the app.

Notifications and Sync
GoatNode supports push notifications via Web Push so your Seeker device can alert you when your feed cooldown ends, when your active window opens, when global fuel is running low, and when you are approaching your daily fuel limit. You must sync your stake once daily through the Waitlist / Stake Sync page to confirm your Guardian pool stake for the upcoming UTC day and queue your next-day fuel. Syncing requires a signed wallet proof and takes seconds. GoatNode resolves your .skr domain name automatically for your identity throughout the app. The app requires wallet connection and geolocation permission to operate, and all sensitive actions are protected by signed wallet authentication or reusable HMAC-secured session tokens.

Whether you enjoy calm maze solving or high-intensity trap runs, CRAZE has a mode for every kind of player.

name: CrushCoin

Experience the best match-three game on Solana. Collect, win, and earn in CrushCoin — the first P2E app optimised for Seeker. Fast and fun!

LOCK · LOAD · SURVIVE

name: Crypto Meme 2048
description: Crypto Meme 2048 is a high-stakes, cyber-styled twist on the classic puzzle game. Swipe and merge your way through the hierarchy of the crypto world, evolving your assets from "Paper Hands" all the way to the legendary "Genesis Block." Featuring smooth animations, immersive synthesized sound effects, and a sleek dark aesthetic, it's the ultimate challenge for meme lovers and crypto enthusiasts alike. Can you reach the moon and secure the top spot on the leaderboard without getting REKT?

name: Crypto Spell
description:
CryptoSpell is a puzzle game where players identify and spell the names of well-known blockchain projects using visual clues and letter tiles.

Explore the Web3 ecosystem through a series of logo-based puzzles inspired by popular crypto platforms and communities.

The game combines word puzzles, brand recognition, and modern digital art styles to create a visually engaging puzzle experience.

Gameplay
Players are shown a crypto project logo or visual clue and must arrange letter tiles to spell the correct project name. As you progress, puzzles become more challenging and introduce additional projects from across the Web3 ecosystem.

The game can be played offline and focuses on puzzle solving, recognition skills, and learning about well-known blockchain brands.

Features

Logo-Based Puzzle Challenges
Solve word puzzles inspired by widely recognized blockchain projects.

Progressive Levels
Difficulty increases gradually as new puzzles and projects are introduced.

Stylized Visual Themes
Includes digital art styles such as Glitch, Cyberpunk, and Pop-Art inspired designs.

Offline Gameplay
Play puzzles anytime without requiring an internet connection.

Optional Web3 Connectivity
CryptoSpell includes optional blockchain-related features such as wallet connectivity and NFT support for compatible devices.
shortDescription: Explore Crypto Projects in a Puzzle Adventure

name: Crypto Trading Simulator
description:
Crypto Trading is an exchange simulator where you can test your skills in crypto futures trading without investments. You start with a virtual balance and trade using real market data, technical indicators, and advanced tools such as leverage and more.
You can trade and view Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), Solana (SOL) and other 1000+ trading pairs on crypto exchange.

This is not a real exchange and there's no risk of losing actual funds. Instead, you get a realistic environment to learn, experiment, and test strategies. Whether you're new to trading or already have experience, the game helps you improve your skills in a fun and competitive way.

You can open long and short positions, use up to 400× leverage, and analyze charts with popular indicators like RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, Supertrend, and others. The platform uses real-time prices, so your decisions are based on actual market conditions.

Challenge other players in weekly tournaments, climb the global leaderboard, and unlock medals for your performance. You can track your stats, success rate, profit percentage, and more. The game is available in multiple languages and works directly in your browser or app, with no registration required.

Crypto Trader - The Game is a safe and engaging way to explore the world of crypto trading. Learn how markets move, test different approaches, and see how far your skills can take you. No deposits, no withdrawals — just virtual trading, real strategy, and pure competition.

If you're curious about crypto trading or want to sharpen your skills in a risk-free environment, this game is made for you. Join thousands of players and become the top virtual trader.
shortDescription: Bitcoin, ETH demo trading app. Simulator game.

name: CryptoMerge

Master the physics, avoid hitting the top limit, and see how high you can score. Simple to play, but hard to master—can you become a crypto whale?

description:
EPOCH 2077: The Great Firewall "Aegis" has locked down the global neural net. You are PROJECT OMEGA—a sentient, rogue algorithm designed to breach the system.
Your code is unstable. Your hunger is infinite. To survive, you must consume raw data packets scattered across the protected sectors. Each byte you devour expands your length and complexity, but the system is watching. Firewalls will tighten. Glitches will manifest.
Grow. Adapt. Overload the system before it purges you.

name: DUJJONCU Universe
description:
Welcome to the DUJJONCU Universe! 🍪
Dive into a premium retro bakery adventure featuring Dujjoncu—a round, chocolate-powdered dessert character! We combine retro gaming with powerful Web3 technology to bring you the ultimate dApp ecosystem.

Join the sweetest Web3 ecosystem now. Connect your wallet, level up your tier, and let the adventure begin!

name: Dank Siege
description:
Dank Siege is a free-to-play meme tower defense game built for Solana Seeker.

Jump in instantly as a guest — no wallet, seed phrase, or payment required to play. During pre-season, every new connected wallet can claim a free starter team, and Seeker Genesis holders can unlock an extra bonus plus an exclusive badge.

Connect a Solana wallet when you want cloud save, leaderboard identity, referrals, pre-season claims, or Seeker Genesis holder bonuses.

Build a 5-tower meme squad and survive across Campaign, Co-op, and PvP. Play quick matches or create private lobbies with friends in Co-op and PvP.

Upgrade your towers, complete quests, climb ranks, and adapt to chaotic runs with Daily Mutations, randomized Chaos Waves, Meme Blessings, Degen Challenges, and new enemy pressure.

Dank Siege is currently in pre-season. Rewards, balance, quests, and economy systems may evolve before Season 1 as the game grows with the community.
shortDescription: Free Meme TD: Co-op, PvP, Daily Mutations

name: DeepDiving
description:
DeepDiving is a play-to-earn arcade mining game built exclusively for Solana.

Mission: Pilot your submarine into the depths of an alien ocean. Drill through distinct geological layers, mine valuable ores from Coal to Diamond, and manage your oxygen supply.

Features:

- Procedural World: Every dive is unique with a massive 10,000-block depth.
- Upgrade System: Use mined resources to upgrade your Drill, Hull, and Oxygen tanks.
- Solana Integration: Connect your wallet to save high scores on-chain and compete on the global leaderboard.
- Token Swap: Seamlessly swap SOL for in-game currency to accelerate your progress securely via the Solana Memo Program.
Can you reach the Core?

description: Have fun with Craig and this Zuma game,hit or create groups of three or more balloons of the same colour to make them pop. You can also swap balloons with a new one of another colour by clicking/touching on the character. You only have five lives to beat the Sewer Queen, are you good enough?

name: Defenders Of the Realm
description:
Elarion has fallen, and the Heart of the village still remembers everyone it once sheltered. Rebuild the town stone by stone, place your walls and towers where they matter, and hold the line as the waves come. 
Awaken the Echoes 
—     the essences of the people the Heart still guards 
—     and take them down into the dungeons beneath the realm.
Build Your Armies, Defend your Realm, Restore the Light to Elarion!

Embark on epic idle expeditions in Degen Idle. Level up your skills, gather rare loot, recruit powerful heroes, and conquer challenging dungeons while you are offline.

Forge your path to glory in a living world filled with endless adventure. Strategize your party, master unique abilities, and climb the leaderboards against players worldwide.

Ride SOL, BONK, JUP, and many more Solana tokens across curated market events like the FTX Collapse or the 2021 Bull Run, trade long or short mid-ride, and don't get liquidated. Climb the global leaderboard in Score Attack, beat the clock in Time Trials, race your own best runs as ghosts. Connect your wallet on Seeker and ride the charts of tokens you actually hold.

description:
Lost the dice? Dice Ex is the sleek dice roller in your pocket — for backgammon, Monopoly, Yahtzee, and every board game that needs a roll.

Tap the screen or shake your phone: the dice tumble with a satisfying animation and haptic feedback, then settle on truly random values.

FEATURES
• Roll 1 to 6 dice — 2 for backgammon, 5 for Yahtzee, your call
• Shake to roll: just shake your phone
• Automatic total calculation
• Haptic feedback on every roll
• Designed for Seeker: deep navy theme with glowing cyan dice
• Fully offline — no internet required

• Tiny size, instant launch

Free version includes 1–2 dice. A one-time premium unlock ($2.99) for all 6 dice via Solana Pay is coming in the next update.

description:
What happens when a time machine experiment goes wrong? Meet Jax. He wanted to fix his past. Instead, he broke the fabric of reality and landed in the prehistoric era, transforming into a dinosaur!

Dino with a Gun is a unique roguelike survivor RPG. You aren't just a dinosaur. You are Jax, a human trapped in a reptile's body defending his new home. The time machine didn't just transport you back in time. It opened portals to the multiverse! Now you must use your mini-gun to blast through waves of zombies, vampires, pirates, and robots invading the prehistoric timeline.

🔥 KEY FEATURES:
• Story-Driven Survival: Play as Jax, a regretful time traveler turned dinosaur hero.
• Multiverse Mayhem: Fight unique enemies you won't see in other dinosaur games. Battle monsters, zombies, ghosts, parasites, robots, and more!
• Roguelike Action: Survive endless waves! Collect XP, unlock tech upgrades, and master wizardry to fix the broken timeline.
• The Ultimate T-Rex: Unleash your Jurassic power! You are the apex predator. Combine your dinosaur instinct with your mini-gun to survive the chaos.
• Survivor IO Gameplay: Fast-paced and addictive. Can you close the portals and survive the horde?

👤 JOIN THE COMMUNITY & SUPPORT
Help improve the game! As a Solo Developer, I am striving to make this the best dinosaur game on the store.
Discord: https://discord.gg/vhB5hkqpFU

ℹ️ PRIVACY POLICY / TERMS OF SERVICE
http://www.jayondope.com/jgamesent/privacy-policy

Command a fire-breathing dragon across 10 stunning worlds and 20 handcrafted levels of fast-paced aerial combat. Take down 10 unique bosses, power up your skills, and earn your place on the leaderboard. Integrated with Solana wallet for secure on-chain identity — no data collected, no ads, no sign-up required. The skies are yours to conquer.

name: Dragon Tower
description:
A single-player test of judgment and composure. Ascend the dragon's tower floor by floor, choosing one tile on each level: pick the safe tile to climb higher and advance the multiplier, but one wrong step ends the round. Stop at any floor to lock in your progress. Built on a straightforward climb-or-stop mechanism, every round runs on transparent, consistent logic — a distraction-free environment for testing your decision-making under pressure.

Please note that all tokens are valueless virtual numbers with no cash-out mechanism, no refunds, and cannot be exchanged for real currency or cryptocurrency. name: Dumb Arcade
description:
Welcome to Dumb Arcade, the official community game for the Something Dumb ($DUMB) ecosystem.

Choose your own path, develop your character and become part of Elderwake’s growing shared world.

name: Empire of Bits
description: Empire of Bits is a mobile-first reactive multiplayer strategy game built on Solana, inspired by the competitive depth of chess and powered by real-time on-chain gameplay. Every move, match state, and interaction is verified through smart contracts, enabling transparent, deterministic, and tamper-resistant competition. The platform introduces a new reactive gaming model where players, streamers, and viewers coexist within the same synchronized on-chain environment. Audiences can participate live through rule-bound interactions, transforming passive spectators into active participants. Designed specifically for Solana Mobile, Empire of Bits showcases low-latency multiplayer execution, wallet-native gameplay, and the future of interactive on-chain gaming.
shortDescription: First Reactive Real-Time Strategy Game on Solana

name: Endless Drifter
description: Endless Drifter is a competitive mobile arcade space-runner where you dodge asteroid fields, collect boosters, upgrade ships and equipment, and chase verified leaderboard scores. Play ranked energy runs, endless Survival, galaxy missions, and free PvP score battles built for Solana Mobile and Seeker.

name: Energy Clicker
description:
Energy Clicker is a daily tap game built on Solana.

Tap the energy orb to charge up, then claim your reward on-chain. Each claim rolls a loot box (Common to Mythic rarity), builds your streak, and upgrades your title from 🌱 Spark all the way to 👑 Eternal.

Compete on the global leaderboard. All progress is stored on-chain — your streak, title, and rank are verifiable by anyone.

• Tap-to-earn energy with combo multiplier
• Daily on-chain claim with loot box
• 6 title tiers unlocked by streak milestones
• Top 10 global leaderboard (on-chain)

shortDescription: Tap to charge. Claim daily. Climb the leaderboard.

name: Epiko Bricks: Match TD
description:
🧱⚔️ EPIKO BRICKS — Match-3 Meets Tower Defence
 
Two genres. One battlefield. Epiko Bricks is a hybrid-casual strategy game that fuses the satisfying click of match-3 puzzles with the tactical thrill of tower defence, where every match decides the fight.
 
✨ THE GAME
 
Each level is a battlefield. Waves of enemies march toward your line. Your weapons? A board of colourful bricks, a wall of customisable towers, and your own strategic mind. Match three or more bricks to charge your defences. Chain combos to unleash devastating attacks. Place your towers wisely: every tile matters.
 
🎮 HOW TO PLAY
 
Match bricks of the same colour to power up your towers
Build combos to chain damage and trigger special attacks
Place defences strategically before each wave
Hold the line and progress through dozens of escalating levels
 
⚔️ KEY FEATURES
 
Innovative hybrid-casual gameplay: match-3 + tower defence in one loop
Strategic tower placement with multiple defence types
Combo-driven combat that rewards smart matches
Wave-based progression across hundreds of levels
Family-friendly, non-violent battles
Easy to pick up, deep to master
Free to play with no aggressive paywalls
 
🛡️ FOR PUZZLE FANS AND STRATEGISTS ALIKE
Love the satisfying click of a great match-3? You'll feel right at home. Love planning the perfect defence? Welcome, commander. Epiko Bricks blends both into a single irresistible loop: match, combo, defend, repeat.
 
🛠️ OPEN BETA — EARLY ACCESS
 
You're playing an early build. Towers are still being balanced and waves are still being tuned. Use Help > Send Feedback in-game, or write to support@epikostudios.com. Your feedback shapes the balance before full launch.

name: Epiko Regal Tower Defense
description:
Prepare for the ultimate battle of all time!

Epiko Regal delivers an unprecedented gaming experience, immersing you in a thrilling world where mythological legends converge. Dive into this high-octane brawler, where strategic tower defense meets relentless combat. Collect trophies, earn points, and anticipate grand rewards.

Download now for free!

This isn't your typical clash of firearms; it's a showdown of swords and sorcery. Brace yourself, wield your weapons, and engage in a battle that relies on skill and strategy rather than machines. After all, isn't there a touch of magic within us all?

But that's not all—prepare for a groundbreaking experience. Gain access to digital AR collectibles and step into the captivating realms of augmented and virtual reality. Witness your heroes come to life right before your eyes!

Claim your spot at the pinnacle of the leaderboards through sheer determination. Join a Kingdom, trade cards with fellow warriors, and engage in friendly duels. But it doesn't stop there; real battles await, offering gold, gems, and cards. Don't forget to unlock exclusive AR collectibles along the way. Dive even deeper into the world of Epiko Regal with our in-house motion comics, the Kathika chapters, and forge connections with the community of heroes.

Features:
- Strategically defend your towers while launching calculated attacks.
- Secure trophies and points in every intense battle.
- Track your progress on the leaderboards, both personal and against friends.
- Team up with friends in multiplayer mode for double the excitement.
- Collect AR treasures and interact with your favorite heroes in real-time.
- Immerse yourself in the all-new motion comics, 'Kathika,' to discover the Epiko Regal universe.
- Challenge your friends in various arenas for legendary clashes.

Are you prepared to unleash your full might in battle? Summon your courage, let adrenaline course through your veins, and get ready for the ultimate showdown. Remember, in Epiko Regal, victory depends on your mastery of both offense and defense—fight until the very end!

name: Epiko Smash: Runner
description:
Epiko Smash is a high-speed 3D cosmic endless runner that blends reflex-driven dodging with heat-based combat and aerial maneuvering. Players pilot a myth-inspired Vimana through vast elemental realms, weaving past obstacles, destroying alien ships, and pushing for high scores in an intense, skill-based flight experience.
 
The core twist: Burnout (Heat) management. Every boost, shot, and evasive maneuver builds heat. Push too hard and your Vimana overheats—slowing movement and leaving you vulnerable. Mastering when to attack, dodge, or cool down becomes the key to survival. With dynamic biomes, limited recovery opportunities, and escalating enemy pressure, every second tests precision, timing, and control.
 
High-speed 3D endless runner with aerial combat
 
Unique Burnout (Heat) management system
 
Precision barrel-roll dodging and evasive maneuvers
 
Dual focus on shooting enemies and obstacle navigation
 
Elemental biomes that dynamically affect gameplay
 
Mythology-inspired Vimana with sci-fi aesthetics
shortDescription: Fly fast, collect hearts, and survive the burnout

Avoid obstacles, and compete with players worldwide in this delightfully gassy game. Features include global leaderboards and hours of entertaining gameplay. Perfect for all ages who enjoy casual arcade-style games. Born from the power of community in Unicorn Fart Dust (UFD).

name: Feed The Chicken - Raise Your Pet on Solana
description:
Feed The Chicken is a Tamagotchi-style pet game built on Solana.
Hatch eggs, care for your pets through 2 growth stages (egg, chicken),
collect rare breed variants across 3 rarity tiers, and use SOL for premium items.

- Equipment system with decay reduction bonuses
- Collect and display your chicken coop

Earn in-game $FLAG token and climb the Leaderboard as you play and learn!

name: Flappy Bird
description: Be a happy little bird, pursue your dreams, and unlock treasures together. There are so many peculiar birds waiting for you. The first season has already begun, it's better to take action than to be tempted. Join us.

name: Flappy Quest Seeker

Complete daily quests, level up your character, unlock skills, and customize your bird with skins and cosmetics from the store. Compete in events, beat high scores, and prove you’re the top flier in this Solana-powered adventure built for Seeker.

name: Flappy Star
description: Flappy Star is a fast-paced arcade game on Solana. Guide your bird through obstacles, collect crypto bonuses and climb the global leaderboard. Choose from 6 unique birds with different stats and abilities. Explore 7 themed worlds — from Forest to Crypto — and dodge hazards like fireballs, asteroids and bear candles. Grab power-ups: shields, magnets, slowdowns and more. Connect any Solana wallet to sign and submit your high scores on-chain. Can you reach the top 10?

name: Flappy bull [Devnet]
description:
Flappy Bull turns the live SOL/USD chart into an arcade obstacle course. Tap
to fly the bull through the gap between price candles — the market decides
where the walls are. Every run streams on-chain in real time on Solana,
powered by MagicBlock Ephemeral Rollups for instant, gasless taps. When you
die, your score commits permanently to a shared, real-time leaderboard.
Spectate live runs, climb the Hall of Degens, and dethrone the bull whisperers.

- Real-time on-chain gameplay via MagicBlock Ephemeral Rollups
- Permanent, shared leaderboard — top 10 all-time per season
- One signature to start; taps are gasless after that

Not financial advice. SOL/USD data used for gameplay only.

name: Game Terminal
description:
Game Terminal is your all-in-one Web3 arcade - a growing collection of 
premium mobile games powered by the Solana blockchain.

🎮 14 GAMES ACROSS EVERY GENRE
Action shooters, physics puzzles, classic arcade, connect & sort games — 
there's always something new to play. Games include:
• Astro Shooter – blast alien waves in deep space
• Parkour Challenge – race across rooftops at full speed
• Jurassic Steel – pilot a mech against dinosaur hordes
• Bubble Shooter, Billiard, Tetris, Sweet Blast & more

🏆 GLOBAL LEADERBOARDS
Compete against players worldwide. Every high score you set is submitted 
to a live global leaderboard — climb the ranks and prove you're the best.

☁️ CLOUD SAVE
Your progress syncs automatically to the cloud. Switch devices or 
reinstall — your levels, scores, and game data are always restored.

🔐 SOLANA WALLET INTEGRATION
Connect your Solana wallet to unlock the full experience. Your wallet 
is your identity — no accounts, no passwords.

⚡ SUBSCRIBE & GO AD-FREE
Remove all ads across every game with a single subscription paid in 
SKR tokens or SOL. Choose 1, 2, or 3 month plans.

🎴 NFT PASS BENEFITS
Hold an Arcade Pass or Astro Pass NFT to unlock permanent ad-free 
gameplay on supported games — no subscription needed, forever free.

New games are added regularly. Download Game Terminal and play everything 
in one place.

name: Gameseekrs
description: GameSeekrs is the first explosive retro arcade platformer built exclusively for Solana Mobile Seeker. Play SeekerRampage — a high-octane Donkey Kong-style game packed with ladders, moving platforms, glitch orbs, and 3 escalating cyber levels. Save high scores on-chain, mint your free Legend SBT after completing Level 3 (first 1000 only), and claim rewards. More addictive arcade titles launching soon!

name: Gasless Lottery
description: Gasless Lottery is a fast and simple crypto lottery on Solana. Buy tickets with SOL and enter hourly draws for a chance to win the entire prize pool. Every round selects a random winner. Watch the jackpot grow, grab your tickets, and see if luck is on your side.
shortDescription: Play the Daily SOL jackpot lottery

name: Genopets
description: Genopets is the gamification of an active lifestyle. Walking around the mall? Jogging at the gym? No matter how you stay active, your Genopet is always by your side, counting the steps you’ll use to fuel your gameplay.

name: GeoChopper
description:
GeoChopper turns learning the world map into a flight. Pilot a helicopter or plane across real maps, race the clock to find countries and cities, and climb the global leaderboards. The sharper your geography, the higher you fly. And on Solana Mobile it goes further: your wallet plugs straight in, your skins are NFTs you truly own, and your loot can pay out real SKR.

Every mission drops you over a real region with a target to find. Steer your craft, trust what you know, and beat the clock. Speed and accuracy both count.

⚡ POWERED BY SOLANA
• Connect your wallet in one tap with Mobile Wallet Adapter.
• Premium skins are collectible NFTs, minted on Solana straight to your wallet: keep them, show them off, or trade them.
• Two Solana-exclusive flagship skins at launch: the Neon Future helicopter and the Full Gold plane.
• Loot boxes can drop real SKR from a limited launch reward pool. Early pilots get the best odds of catching it.
• Pay your way: SOL, SKR or USDC from your wallet, or CHOPPER coins you earn by flying.

💎 LIMITED COLLECTOR PIECES
• Golden Loot Seeker: a utility NFT capped at 100 that boosts every loot box you open. Once they are gone, they are gone.
• Unbreakable Streak Shield: an ultra-rare loot box drop that protects your daily streak. Only 500 will ever exist.
• Achievement NFTs for true feats of exploration, like finding all the Ancient Wonders.

🚁 THREE WAYS TO FLY
• Missions: your scored, ranked flights. Find five targets against the clock to earn Flight XP and a place on the leaderboards.
• Discovery: free-roam the map at your own pace, uncover famous landmarks, and grow your Landmarks Collection. No timer, no pressure.
• Training Flights: free practice that targets your weak spots and mixes in new places. No leaderboard, and hints are always free.

🌍 A WHOLE WORLD TO MASTER
• Fly the entire globe or zoom into a single country.
• Find countries, cities, provinces and famous landmarks.
• Multiple difficulty tiers, from Easy to Extreme.
• Two aircraft that fly completely differently: a nimble helicopter and a faster, wider-turning plane.

📈 LEVEL UP EVERY FLIGHT
• Earn Flight XP and rise through a full pilot career, from Novice Pilot all the way to Legend.
• Fill loot boxes as you level up and unlock skins, trails, coins and SKR.
• Build daily streaks for bonus rewards.
• Collect achievements and rank badges that appear next to your name.

🎨 MAKE IT YOURS
• Unlock skins and trails for both your helicopter and your plane.
• Earn them by playing, or mint your favorites as NFTs with SOL, SKR or USDC.
• Ten skins at launch, every one of them mintable to your wallet.

🏆 COMPETE WORLDWIDE
• Daily, weekly and all-time leaderboards for every map and difficulty.
• See how you stack up against pilots everywhere.

🎓 GEOGRAPHY THAT STICKS
GeoChopper is a game first, but you come out knowing the map. Real coastlines, borders and cities put actual places under your fingertips until they are second nature. It is a genuinely fun way for kids and adults alike to get better at world geography.

✅ FREE TO PLAY, PLAYER FRIENDLY
• Free to download and play.
• No ads.
• No cross-app tracking.
• Fully localized, so you can learn the world in your language.
• Playing never requires a wallet: connect one only when you want the Solana extras.

Missions use Mission Tickets that refill over time, so there is always another flight on the way. Optional purchases like extra tickets and NFT skins are entirely up to you, paid from your wallet in SOL, SKR or USDC.

Ready for takeoff? Fly, explore, own the sky.
shortDescription: Fly the map and master world geography

GoldenFlop is a real-time multiplayer Texas Hold'em poker game built on Solana. Connect your wallet, join a table, and play poker with instant SOL settlements.
Features: - Real-time 6-player Texas Hold'em tables - Multiple stake tiers from Micro to VIP - Practice mode with free chips - Real stakes with SOL and SEEKER tokens - Non-custodial design — your keys, your crypto - Instant deposits and withdrawals on Solana - No monthly fees or withdrawal charges - Emoji reactions and social features - Retro pixel art style

Gangs of blood thirsty critters have taken the city. Only P.D. Mitch Birman and a trunk full of guns can stop them.

description:
Hell Seeker is a fast-paced survival wave game where you fight endless enemies, level up your character, and upgrade your stats to survive increasingly difficult waves. Stay alive, adapt your build, and push as far as you can against relentless attackers.

“Hold the line! Do not let enemies hit the red dot center.”

name: HOLDOUT
description: Skill-based multiplayer survival game. Keep your finger on the screen and complete 100+ reflex challenges as they appear - tap, shake, keep the device level, and many more. The longer you hold, the bigger your share of the prize pool. Proof-of-Human anti-cheat keeps the field fair

name: HOOP COLOR SORT
description:
Hoop Color Sort is a captivating and addictive puzzle game designed to challenge your mind and help you relax! Sort the colorful hoops onto the correct stacks until all colors match. It sounds simple, but as you progress, the puzzles become increasingly complex and require sharp logic and strategic thinking.

Whether you have a few minutes to spare or want to dive into an immersive brain-training session, Hoop Color Sort provides endless hours of fun. Test your problem-solving skills, improve your focus, and become a color sorting master!

🧠 How to Play: • Tap any stack to move the top hoop to a different stack. • You can only move a hoop on top of another hoop if both have the same color and the destination stack has enough space. • Strategize your moves to avoid getting stuck! • Successfully group all identical colors together on a single stack to clear the level.

✨ Game Features: • Simple & Intuitive Controls: Just tap to play. Easy to learn, difficult to master! • Hundreds of Challenging Levels: Enjoy a massive variety of puzzles ranging from beginner-friendly to mind-bendingly difficult. • Brain Training: Exercise your logical thinking and cognitive skills with every move. • Relaxing Gameplay: Play at your own pace with no time limits or stressful penalties. • Vibrant Graphics: Enjoy satisfying colors, smooth animations, and clean visual design. • Play Anywhere, Anytime: 100% playable offline. No internet connection required!

Can you solve them all? Download Hoop Color Sort today, organize the colors, and give your brain the perfect puzzle workout!

name: HOTW
description:
Description

Heroes of the West (HOTW) is a fantasy RPG & strategy game built on Solana. Command your Champion, build your strength, explore a rich fantasy world, and compete for rewards. HOTW combines classic strategy gameplay with blockchain-powered ownership and rewards, giving players a new way to experience the world of Heroes of the West.

name: Happy Guess
description:
Happy Guess is an educational game that helps users learn about Solana ecosystem dAPPs through an engaging guessing game.
GAMEPLAY: - View dAPP icons and use hints to guess their names - 20+ built-in Solana dAPPs including Magic Eden, Phantom, Jupiter, and more - Three-level hint system to help you guess - Score points and build combos for consecutive correct answers
FEATURES: - 20+ popular Solana dAPPs to learn about - Three hint levels per question - Score and combo mechanics - Full bilingual support (Chinese/English) - Statistics tracking for your progress - Categories include DeFi, NFT, Gaming, Tools, and more
This is the second app from Happy Racing Studio, the developer of Happy Racing (快乐赛车) on Solana dAPP Store.

name: Happy Racing
description:
Happy Racing is an exciting mobile racing game built on the Solana blockchain.
GAMEPLAY: - Dodge oncoming traffic by swiping left and right to switch lanes - Survive for 60 seconds to win - Each win earns you +2 points, crashes cost -1 point - Compete on the global leaderboard
BLOCKCHAIN FEATURES: - Connect your Phantom wallet to play - Game scores stored on-chain for transparency - Anti-cheat system with on-chain hash verification - Recharge points with USDC (1 USDC = 1 point) - Fully decentralized leaderboard
FEATURES: - Smooth 60fps gameplay - Multiple NPC car colors and increasing difficulty - Sound effects for engine, crashes, and countdown - Portrait mode optimized for Solana mobile devices

name: Head Soccer World Cup
description: A fun and fast-paced football game where you control big-headed soccer players in World Cup matches. Use your head to hit the ball, score amazing goals, beat rival teams, and win the ultimate World Cup championship.
shortDescription: Head your way to World Cup glory!

name: Honeyland
description:
Join players worldwide as you build your swarm of bees, harvest sweet rewards, compete in quests and PVP battles to collect as much honey as you can for your Hive.  
Explore the vast lands across the universe in Honeyland, manage your bees, and earn tools and resources to help you along the way. Your Swarm is waiting for you. 
With vibrant graphics and intuitive gameplay, Honeyland is the perfect game for anyone who loves strategy games and adorable bees. 

Welcome to Universe 1 
● Build and manage your swarm of bees, upgrade their skills so they can produce more honey 
● Collect honey by harvesting across the universe 
● Collect items along the way to help upgrade your bees and earn faster 
● Mate your bees and queen to create more playable characters to help you earn faster.  
● Complete quests to hone your PVP skills and earn sweet rewards 
● Compete against other players in an idle battle to win honey   
● Protect your hive from attacks from other players 
● Customize your Hive to make it uniquely yours with unique decorations, backgrounds, and more  
● Claim your free daily spin to win free items 
● Enjoy beautiful graphics and intuitive gameplay 
What are you waiting for? Join the Honey rush today.

name: Hunters of Faenora
description:
Welcome to Faenora.
It’s a beautiful place, once you get used to the danger.

To The Grave: The Hunters of Faenora is a free-to-play tactical RPG set in the medieval realm of Faenora. A gate to the netherrealm has been breached and the Wildlands of Faenora have been sealed off from the rest of the Kingdom. Mercenaries and vagabonds show up in the town of Donegal to hunt foul beasts for fame and fortune. But is there a greater danger beneath the surface?

Combat is turn-based and deeply tactical. Positioning matters. Squad composition matters. Every decision carries weight and not every Hunter makes it home. The stakes are permadeathly high. And the rewards, legendary.

Hunters exist as onchain NFTs with their stats, class, traits and achievements persisting beyond a single run. NFT game characters are swappable into and from MCHY tokens (usable in-game). Recruit new warriors, refine their abilities, customize their appearance and push deeper into the adventure.

You can play for free.
You can choose onchain ownership and high stakes, high reward gameplay.
Faenora will meet you where you are.

Free to Play. Easy to Try. Hard to Master.
shortDescription: Best Roguelite Tactical RPG in Web3

name: I See Fortune
description: Solana epoch based prediction game where players choose numbers and compete for SOL rewards using fully transparent outcome generation. Winning numbers are derived from finalized on-chain data, making results independently verifiable by anyone. No hidden servers, no private randomness, and no “trust us” mechanics. Just simple gameplay, public chain data, and provably fair outcomes built for degens who trust no one.

New display modes included in all levels and an extra hard 'Zen' mode (no helpful backgrounds) if you really want to test yourself
shortDescription: You could be here for a while...

shortDescription: Infinite Minesweeper with Web3 Rewards on Solana.

name: Infinite Minefield
description:
♾️ INFINITE WARFARE
Experience the classic logic puzzle on an endless, procedurally generated battlefield. Use smooth gestures to zoom, pan, and secure the perimeter.

🔍 TACTICAL GAMEPLAY
• Infinite Scrolling Grid: No edges, just pure strategy.
• Dynamic Difficulty: Recruit (Easy), SpecOps (Medium), and Veteran (Hard).
• Zero Emojis: All assets are high-fidelity tactical graphics.

⛓️ SOLANA INTEGRATION

📱 BUILT FOR SEEKER

No wallet required to play. Connect when you are ready to immortalize your high score.

name: Interstellar Command
description: Interstellar Command is a real-time strategy game that places you at the helm of your own starship, commanding a fleet in dynamic space battles. Built on Solana using MagicBlock's Ephemeral Rollups, Flagship delivers low-latency gameplay where every decision is executed directly on-chain. Experience the thrill of space warfare as you navigate your fleet, engage in tactical combat, and make strategic decisions that influence the outcome of each battle. With MagicBlock's infrastructure, actions are processed swiftly, ensuring a seamless and responsive gaming experience. Whether you're coordinating attacks, managing resources, or exploring new territories, Interstellar Command offers a unique blend of strategy and real-time action, all within a decentralized framework. Dive into the universe of Interstellar Command and assert your dominance in the galaxy.

name: Iter Coloris
description:
Iter Coloris is an exploration-driven RPG set in a universe built entirely from color. You play as a scientist searching for the color genome. One night, he falls asleep and wakes up in a reality where color is not just a property of light, but the very substance of existence.

Accompanied by the Chromes, entities defined by their unique spectra, you explore a world shaped by mysterious architects known as the Essences. Experimentation, crafting, and interaction with the environment are at the core of the experience. Unlock blueprints, craft items, and design custom gear as you uncover the logic behind this vibrant universe.

The game blends RPG progression, color-based puzzles, and exploration. PvP battles, team missions, leaderboards, and seasonal events are on the way. AI companions will assist without taking control, and a player-driven economy with native tokens and an NFT marketplace is also in development.

Iter Coloris is a living world where color is both story and system. Curiosity drives the journey, and the ending is yours to discover.

name: JankenDegen
description: Compete with other degens in Rock Paper Scissors, Raffle, Dice Pool, and Russian Roulette.

name: Jimbo’s Adventure
description:
Jimbo’s Adventure is a high-speed endless runner where you play as Jimbo the cat running through a post-apocalyptic city

Dodge obstacles, jump over hazards, ride over the environment, and collect coins in a run that gets tougher every second

Designed for quick sessions and long-term progression, the game lets you complete missions, compete on the leaderboard, and earn rewards through the Seeker ecosystem

Pure runner gameplay, real competition, and a world worth coming back to
shortDescription: Run, collect coins, and dodge obstacles with Jimbo

name: Jimothy Crossing
description:
Jimothy is hungry. The road is busy. Nobody taught him to look both ways.

Tap to hop forward. Swipe to dodge. Get as far as you can before a taxi,
a dog, or the river finds him — then immediately try again, because you
were definitely about to beat your best.

ONE TAP, NO TUTORIAL
Understood in three seconds. A run lasts under a minute. There is no
level select, no energy timer, and nothing to read before you play.

AN ENDLESS NEIGHBOURHOOD
Every run generates a fresh stretch of grass, roads, rivers, backyards
and parks. Traffic thickens the further you push. The layout is checked
as it is built, so there is always a way through — if you can find it.

SNACKS ARE POINTS
Pizza, burgers, fries and donuts line the route. String pickups together
without missing one and the multiplier climbs. Take the risky lane for
the golden pizza, or play it safe and watch someone else's score go up.

FAILING IS THE FUN PART
Every way to go out has its own animation. Getting flattened by a taxi
is funnier than surviving, and you will want to show someone.

COLLECT AND UNLOCK
Snacks bank between runs and buy new looks for Jimothy. Cosmetic only —
nothing you unlock makes the road any safer.

Free. Portrait. Plays with one thumb.
shortDescription: Hop the road, dodge the cars

name: Jurassic Steel
description:
Jurassic Steel — Mecha Dinosaur Battle on Solana

Take control of massive steel-armored dinosaurs and fight through intense mecha combat — now with full Solana wallet integration.

⚔️ GAMEPLAY
Fast-paced mecha dinosaur battles optimized for mobile. Dodge, strike, and survive escalating waves of enemies in landscape action gameplay.

🔗 SOLANA FEATURES
• Connect your Solana wallet (Phantom, Backpack, and more via Mobile Wallet Adapter)
• Subscribe with SKR tokens for a fully ad-free experience
• Hold a Retro Game Pass NFT for automatic Pro access
