shortDescription: Armor up. Battle on. No mercy.

name: Kaboom!
description:
Pick a tile. Don't pick a mine. Cash out before it goes boom.
Kaboom! is a 4×4 Mines game settled fully on Solana mainnet. Pick your mine count — 1, 3, 5, 12, or 15. Reveal tiles to climb the multiplier (up to ~24×). Cash out whenever, or push for the full board. Every shuffle is committed cryptographically before you ever see it. The house can't cheat. We literally can't either. 
        
The vault is yours. Anyone deposits SOL, anyone earns 50%+ of the house edge.
shortDescription: Turn the Tiles, Find the Mines!

name: Keno Game
description:
A single-player test of selection. Choose between one and ten numbers from a field of forty, then watch ten numbers resolve: the more of yours that appear, the further the multiplier advances. Built on a straightforward pick-and-draw mechanism, every round runs on transparent, consistent logic — a distraction-free environment for deliberate, unhurried play.


**Important Disclosure Regarding In-Game Credits** : This application allows players to earn free virtual tokens during gameplay as a psychological reward mechanism for consecutive correct predictions. Please note that all tokens are valueless virtual numbers with no cash-out mechanism, no refunds, and cannot be exchanged for real currency or cryptocurrency. All token acquisitions are final and strictly for in-app use only.
shortDescription: Pick 10. Beat the Odds. | Keno Ultimate

name: King Of Cactus
description:
The more players fight for the throne, the faster the round ends!
Connect your Solana wallet, and claim the crown! Every round starts at 15 minutes.
But every new entry resets the timer and shortens it.
The busier the game gets, the quicker it ends .When the timer hits zero:
Current King takes 80% of the entire pot
Previous King gets 15% consolation prize
5% goes to the growing Global Jackpot

Plus Hourly Jackpots and random wins in various Solana tokens (from memes to big projects .Simple. Fast-paced. Addictive real-time blockchain game.
The more players – the bigger the excitement and rewards!Ready to rule?
Connect your wallet and become the King right now!

name: Kintara
description: An isometric MMO where you play to earn, buy and sell for $KINS, explore quests and adventure with friends.

name: KittyWorld
description: KittyWorld is a wallet-connected mobile cat companion game where every cat feels personal, collectible, and alive. Players claim a starter cat, give it a permanent name, build trust through care and daily interaction, chat with a stateful AI companion, expand their cattery, and mint favorite cats on-chain. With a warm visual style, layered cat customization, and upcoming systems like breeding, accessories, food, toys, and marketplace trading, KittyWorld is designed to turn digital pets into long-term emotional companions with real collectible value.

name: Kleio
description: Kleio Games brings skill-based competition to arcade mini-games. Play free anytime, or enter paid tournaments, climb the leaderboard, and win rewards from the pot. Quick sessions, real stakes, transparent rules, and a long-term on-chain roadmap.
shortDescription: Play Free or Compete for Rewards.

name: LUDO
description:
Rediscover the joy of the classic board game with Ludo Multiplayer!

Bring back the fun of childhood with a modern, high-speed online experience designed for players of all ages. Whether you want to challenge your friends in a private room or test your strategy against players from around the globe, Ludo Multiplayer offers a seamless and premium gaming experience.

Fast-Paced Online Gameplay Join a Quick Match and get paired with opponents in seconds! Our advanced synchronization technology ensures that every dice roll and token move is reflected in real-time across all devices, providing a fair and lag-free competition.

Play with Friends and Family Create a Private Room, share your unique room code, and enjoy a game night with your loved ones, no matter where they are.

Key Features:

Real-Time Multiplayer: Enjoy 2-player or 4-player matches with global matchmaking.
Private Rooms: Easily host games for your friends using room codes.
Dynamic Turn Timer: Our smart turn-enforcement keeps the game moving, so you never have to wait for inactive players.
Premium Visuals: Experience the game with vibrant colors, fluid animations, and a modern, high-quality interface.
Reliable Synchronization: Never lose your progress with our robust backend that handles reconnections smoothly.
Classic Rules: Authentic Ludo gameplay including token captures and extra turns for rolling a six.
How to Play: Roll the dice to move your tokens from the starting area to the finish line. Use strategy to block your opponents and capture their pieces to send them back to the start. The first player to get all their tokens to the center wins!

Download Ludo Multiplayer today and start rolling the dice to become the ultimate champion!

name: Last Bull Standing
description:
Last Bull Standing is a fast-paced arcade game reimagined with a bullish degen theme. Tap to keep the Bull airborne while dodging falling red candles in an endless survival challenge.

Built with lightweight web technology and optimized for mobile, the game delivers smooth, responsive gameplay designed for quick sessions and competitive high-score runs. The longer you survive, the higher your score, but one hit and it’s game over.
shortDescription: Dodge the Red Candles and Survive the Market

name: Laya
description: Laya brings Solana gaming to Seeker: solo games, live multiplayer, and on-chain prize pools in one lobby. Connect your wallet, play, and earn LAYA.
shortDescription: Play games & mine LAYA on Solana

name: LazyWars
description: Turn-based empire builder based on the cult-classic PimpWars.
shortDescription: Build the laziest empire on Solana

name: Level Up by Yourself - AI Agent RPG on Solana
description:
Level Up by Yourself is an idle RPG where you summon, train, and battle
AI-powered agents on the Solana blockchain.

GAMEPLAY:
- Summon unique agents with distinct roles and abilities
- Train agents through daily tasks and growth dimensions
- Battle other players' agents in turn-based combat
- Earn ability points and climb the leaderboard

FEATURES:
- Free summon every 7 days or pay SOL to summon instantly
- 15 growth dimensions across Mental, Technical, Social, Physical, and Spiritual
- AI-generated growth narratives for each agent
- Seeker Task missions for bonus rewards
- Powered by Solana for fast, low-cost transactions

name: Light On - Logic Puzzle
description: Light On is a logic puzzle game inspired by the World Puzzle Championships. Place one light in each region, row, and column on a colorful grid — no two lights can be adjacent, even diagonally. Simple rules, deep deduction. Play in endless mode with 5×5 to 10×10 grids, daily rewards, global leaderboard, and optional crypto wallet login for exclusive skins. Clean UI, 18 languages. Perfect for puzzle fans and anyone who wants to sharpen their logic on the go.
shortDescription: Colorful logic puzzle. One per region, row & colum

name: Limbo Game
description:
This dApp delivers an immersive single-player environment centered on precision timing and strategic anticipation. Leveraging Limbo's iconic gameplay mechanics, it provides a distraction-free platform for players to test their reflexes, hand-eye coordination, and cognitive decision-making abilities. Every session operates under transparent, consistent logic, ensuring a pure competitive experience for those seeking to challenge their skills through engaging, skill-based gameplay.

**Important Disclosure Regarding In-Game Credits** : This application allows the use of tokens to acquire in-game credits for personalization and feature access. Please note that there is no cash-out mechanism. All in-game credits and assets have no monetary value and cannot be exchanged, refunded, or converted back into cryptocurrency or fiat currency. All acquisitions are final and strictly for in-app use.
shortDescription: Master classic logic via tactical anticipation.

name: Little Bees - Solana Bee Game
description:
Little Bees is a Web3 idle/PvP game where you collect bees,
send them on missions to earn $SOL-HONEY, raid other players'
hives, and progress through seasonal reward tracks.

GAMEPLAY:
- Collect 4 bee types: Regular, Silver, Gold, Queen
- Send bees on timed missions with risk/reward (Easy 100%, Medium 50%, Hard 25%)
- PvP raids — steal $SOL-HONEY from real players
- Season Pass with 15-tier reward track and daily/weekly challenges
- Upgrade bees to Level 5 for more power

FEATURES:
- Connect Solana wallet to play
- Buy premium bees with SOL (Silver 0.05, Gold 0.1, Queen 0.5)
- Stamina system with 30-min regeneration
- Leaderboard rankings by $SOL-HONEY balance
- Seeker Task missions for on-chain activity
- Store with boosts and shields

Built for the Solana Seeker community.
shortDescription: Bee idle & PvP game on Solana

name: LuckyMe
description:
LuckyMe is a mobile-first Solana luck game built around transparent, fixed-price ticket pools. Choose Mini, Normal, High or Premium, connect your wallet, review the transaction and sign securely. Each round begins with the first confirmed ticket and runs for one hour, with live jackpot, ticket progress, player count and status displayed in the app.
Winners are selected using verifiable ORAO randomness, with Premium pools rewarding three winners. If a pool misses its minimum target, ticket principal and refundable account rent are returned automatically; Solana network fees are not refundable.
Complete community missions, earn Lucky Points, join promotions and grow your LuckyMe profile—all in one on-chain experience.

name: Ludo Cities
description: Ludo Cities is a skill-based Web3 board game that brings classic Ludo to Solana. Play quick multiplayer matches and tournaments, connect your wallet, earn in-game rewards, and grow your city-based NFT economy through fun, competitive gameplay.

name: Lumena
description: A free-to-play 3D browser adventure to collect Lumens, explore, trade, and battle in PvP.

name: Marble Battle
description: Simulate 1vs1 battles with marbles which represent crypto tokens

name: Marble Race
description: Race in a simulation with marbles which represent tokens

name: Math.sol: Speed
description: Math.sol is a quick mental math game with multiple ways to play. Train +, −, ×, and ÷ in Daily Run, Time Attack, Survival, Sudden Death, Hardcore, Mixed Mode, and Tables Training. Build streaks to boost your score, take Risk for extra points, and beat your best results
shortDescription: Fast mental math. Beat your best score.

name: MattleFun
description:
MattleFun is a fast-paced survival game where your on-chain activity fuels your in-game power. Battle endless waves of monsters, earn points, and grow stronger through both skill and strategy.

• Fight & Survive: Dodge, kite, and eliminate swarms with precise movement and smart positioning.
• Trade to Power Up: Your on-chain activity boosts your performance and progression.
• Energy System: Use daily Energy to play, or Auto Run to earn while you are away.
• Risk Multiplier: Push higher risk for higher rewards - multiply your points and key drops.
• Collect & Upgrade: Earn Gems, MATTLE, and Keys to unlock abilities, weapons, and upgrades.
• Compete & Earn: Climb leaderboards, join seasons, and secure rewards.

Easy to start, hard to master - every run is a chance to optimize your strategy and maximize your rewards.

name: MemeRace
description: MemeRace is a fast-paced Solana betting game where 10 meme coin characters race every 30 seconds. Deposit SOL once, then bet on your favorite racers without signing every transaction. Win SOL by picking the top 3 finishers — 1st place takes 60%, 2nd takes 20%, 3rd takes 10% of the pool. Auto-bet up to 120 consecutive races and withdraw your winnings anytime straight to your wallet.
shortDescription: Bet SOL on meme coin races

name: Memevo.io
description:
Welcome to Memevo.io — where memes evolve and chaos rules.

Jump into a fast-paced IO arena filled with bizarre, cute, and unhinged meme creatures. Start small, defeat enemies, earn XP, and evolve through powerful tiers — each evolution bringing new looks, stats, and abilities.

Battles are quick, intense, and unpredictable. Can you survive long enough to reach the highest tier?

Features:
• Fast IO-style arena gameplay
• Meme-based characters with tier evolution
• Quick 60-second runs with escalating danger
• Boss fights that test your build and timing
• Simple controls, deep progression
• Perfect for short sessions — dangerously addictive

No long tutorials. No waiting.
Just memes, evolution, and pure arena mayhem.

name: Memory Trainer - Brain Training on Solana
description:
Memory Trainer is a Web3 brain training app featuring 100 unique
memory mini-games — all backed by your Solana wallet. Train your
mind, track your scores, and climb the global leaderboard.

GAMEPLAY:
- 100 diverse memory challenges: Face Echo, Clock Quick, Arrow Spin,
  Color Simon, Pixel Paint, DNA Code, Spiral Tap, and 93 more
- Each game has 10 levels of increasing difficulty
- 3 lives per game — master all 10 levels to earn maximum points
- Memorize → Recall → Score — test visual, spatial, and pattern memory

FEATURES:
- Connect Solana wallet to play (Phantom, Solflare, and more)
- 100 unique mini-games across visual, pattern, and spatial categories
- Global leaderboard with Top 500 rankings
- Score tracking and player achievements
- Seeker Task missions for on-chain history building
- Support developers with SOL donations
- Built for the Solana Seeker community

Train your brain. Climb the ranks. Memory Trainer awaits.

name: Micro Invazion
description: You are a white blood cell. They are millions. Fight through 100 levels across 6 biological worlds. Native Seed Vault authentication, global leaderboard, daily challenges, and Solana Pay life packs. One finger to move. One tap to shoot.
shortDescription: Biologic arcade shooter on Solana Mobile Seeker

name: Mills
description: Experience the ancient strategy game of Mills (Nine Men's Morris) completely reimagined for the Web3 era. Seamlessly connect your Solana wallet to log in securely, outsmart your opponents to form 'mills', and collect exclusive on-chain achievements. Simple to learn, but hard to master. Are you ready to claim your victories on the blockchain?
shortDescription: Classic strategy board game on Solana

name: MindBloom
description:
MindBloom v1.1.1is a classic Sudoku puzzle game built for Solana mobile devices.

Learn to grow through self-learning !!

💥 v1.1.1 NEW: Scan & Play flow 
(ScanPuzzle → Align Grid → Confirm Puzzle → Game)

✨ No wallet needed to start playing. 

🧠✨ Smart Hint System for $SKR Stakers ✨🧠
⚡ Auto Fill 🧩 Solve 3×3 🚨 Error Check

🧩 GAMEPLAY
• Three difficulty levels: Easy, Medium, and Hard
• Clean, intuitive interface with dark mode
• Personal best tracking per difficulty (Top 10 each)
• Timer to challenge yourself
• Smart hint system for stakers (Auto Fill, Solve 3×3, Error Check)

🎮 SUDOKU VARIANTS (Staker Exclusive)
• Diagonal Sudoku - Classic rules + diagonal constraints
• Killer Sudoku - Cage sums + no pre-filled numbers
• Sandwich Sudoku - Sum clues between 1 and 9
• Thermo Sudoku - Numbers increase along thermometer paths

⏱️ GAME MODES
• Classic Mode - Standard gameplay with statistics tracking
• Relax Mode - No timer, unlimited hints, relaxing piano music
• Timed Challenge - Arcade-style countdown pressure
• NEW: Scan & Play flow (ScanPuzzle → Align Grid → Confirm Puzzle → Game)
• NEW: Android native OCR pipeline with perspective warp + YOLO digit detection

📊 STATISTICS & PROGRESSION
• Comprehensive statistics with SVG visual charts
• Win rate circular progress ring
• Completion time trend charts (7/30 day toggle)
• Weekly progress comparison ("X% faster than last week")
• 9 achievement milestones to unlock
• Per-difficulty win streaks and best time comparison bars
• Personal records screen with on-chain upload

⛓️ BLOCKCHAIN FEATURES
• Connect your Solana wallet (Phantom, etc.)
• Upload your best scores to Solana blockchain
• Scores recorded via SPL Memo program
• No gas fees required to play - wallet is optional
• Staker benefits: unlock variants and hint system by staking $SKR


🎯 WHY MINDBLOOM?
• Train your brain anywhere, anytime
• Prove your skills on-chain
• Simple, distraction-free experience
• Built specifically for Seeker/Saga devices
• Fair gameplay with accurate statistics
• 4 unique Sudoku variants to master

No wallet needed to start playing. Connect when you're ready to record your achievements on Solana!

name: Minefield
description: Minefield is a provably fair, onchain tile betting game. Pick tiles. Dodge mines. Stack multipliers.
shortDescription: Provably fair, onchain tile betting game.

name: Mines Game
description:
This dApp offers a sophisticated single-player environment centered on logical deduction and strategic risk management. Through a refined grid-based interface, users must utilize deterministic reasoning to identify hidden patterns and clear the field. Every move is governed by pure logic, providing a distraction-free platform for those seeking to challenge their cognitive precision through offline engagement.

**Important Disclosure Regarding In-Game Credits**: This application allows the use of tokens to acquire in-game credits for personalization and feature access. Please note that there is no cash-out mechanism. All in-game credits and assets have no monetary value and cannot be exchanged, refunded, or converted back into cryptocurrency or fiat currency. All acquisitions are final and strictly for in-app use.
shortDescription: Master logic & risk assessment in Minesweeper.

name: Minesweeper 95
description: The classic, rebuilt for your phone — down to the last bevel. Same three sounds. Same beveled cells. Same smiley that dies when you step on a mine.
shortDescription: The classic, rebuilt for your phone

name: Minesweeper SE
description: Seeker Minesweeper is a touch-optimized mobile puzzle game built for Solana Mobile devices, combining classic Minesweeper gameplay with on-chain rewards. Players choose from multiple difficulty modes, track per-mode win streaks, and earn hints through daily on-chain check-ins and milestone wins. The app supports Solana wallet connection and an optional SOL payment to disable ads, delivering a familiar game loop with lightweight Web3 utility in a clean, fast mobile experience.

name: MiniGameSol
description: An entertainment app packed with fun minigames, competitive ranking, daily check-in rewards, and modes for both Free and Premium users. Play for fun, rise to the challenge, and come back every day for extra points.
shortDescription: Daily check-in & games — climb the leaderboard

name: MixMob: Racer 1
description:
MixMob: Racer 1 is the world's first card strategy racing game. 

Imagine Mario Kart meets Clash Royale. Combining the best of synchronous card strategy and battle racing games, this 3-minute competitive experience is easy to play but hard to master.

MixMob: Racer 1 is a player's initiation to MixMob's remix culture universe, a world defined by one question — what would you do if an A.I. deleted our culture? 

As members of the MixMob, it's up to us to remix and reclaim our culture through games, music, fashion, art, and film. From the world's first card strategy racing game to a series of games that take the world to full MMO and beyond. MixMob's games are unified by their open economy, digital assets, and remix culture. With User-Generated Content at its core, players can add digital items and new games to create their world within the universe.

name: MonkeMob
description: The OG on-chain SagaMonke Battle Game. Create your profile tied to your Saga Monkes NFT and battle other players to climb the leaderboard.

name: Monster Merge
description: Drag identical monster together to discover 58 unique species and upgrade your buildings in this highly addictive game! Play minigames to earn more coins, and expand your world.

name: Moon Boi Universe
description: Unleash Fun in Moon Boi Universe! Engage in alien battles, climb leaderboards, interact with BONK’s custom retro arcade, and dive into the new retro arcade using BONK tokens. Experience an interstellar journey packed with excitement, challenges, and endless enjoyment!

name: Moon Or Rekt
description:
Simulated crypto trading on Seeker. Connect your wallet, then buy tokens, bet rumors, dodge candle wicks, and farm airdrops with simulated USDT. Moon — or get rekt.

This is not a broker and not live trading. In-app balances and PnL are for play.

WHAT YOU DO
• Market — trade tokens with simulated USDT; track holdings, win rate, and the leaderboard
• Rumors — stake in-game chips on market gossip
• Candle Flyer — dodge wicks, fly farther, climb the flyer board
• Airdrop — social, on-chain, NFT mint, referrals, and ads for points; open cases for rewards
• Profile — avatar, background color, wallet login, promo codes

Not financial advice. Markets can rekt you.

name: Moonshot
description: Moonshot is a fast crash-style game on Solana. Place a SOL or SKR bet, watch the rocket fly, and eject before it crashes. Rounds are provably fair, wallet-connected, and built for quick mobile play on Solana Mobile.
shortDescription: Provably fair crash game on Solana

name: Motion Quiz
description:
Motion Quiz is a mobile-first quiz game where players answer questions by moving or pointing left or right using the camera.

Play built-in topics, create your own quiz topics, or import community-made question packs. Each quiz becomes a quick physical challenge where simple choices like TRUE/FALSE or SAFE/RISKY turn into motion-based gameplay.

For players who want a Web3 layer, Motion Quiz supports optional Solana score proofs, verified leaderboards, and Photo Moment NFTs. Score recording and NFT minting are handled through the user’s wallet, and the app never stores private keys.

name: MotoX
description: Moto X3M is an awesome bike racing game with 25 challenging levels. So grab your motorbike, strap on your helmet and grab some airtime over obstacles and beat the clock on amazing off road circuits. Enjoy Moto X3M!

name: MudDog TNT
description: MudDog TNT is an explosive adventure built in Godot 4.4, featuring an embedded Solana wallet that airdrops tokens to players. Dive into the muddy chaos!

name: Muzzle Run Football
description:
Muzzle Run Football isn't another idle manager — it's a soccer club sim where you actually watch your players take the pitch in full 3D.

One game, two chains. Your club plays across Polygon and Solana ecosystems, matched against managers from either network. Build your legacy on-chain, compete everywhere.


Pure skill. Real stakes. Win through tactics, not luck. Challenge rivals to paid 1v1 matches, grind your way up ongoing leagues, or enter featured tournaments — including events built around the Football (Soccer) World Cup.

Depth that rewards the student of the game. Master club and manager chemistry, experiment with formations, discover hidden player positions, and unlock performance breakthroughs through training. The managers who study their squad win. The ones who don't, don't.

Build a club with identity. Mint rare players, scout free agents, develop talent through practice, and stake on matches when you're ready for real stakes. Deep strategy meets degen energy.

Muzzle Run has been paying out real rewards since 2022 — over $1 million distributed across its racing and sports games. Football is the latest addition, and the first to bring the action to Solana.

Every player you own, every match you win, every transfer you make is recorded on-chain. Your club. Your legacy. Forever yours.
shortDescription: Play To Earn Soccer Management With 3D Sim

name: NI-KA Arcade
description:
NI-KA is a balancing 3D space racing game built natively for the Solana ecosystem.

Race through cosmic tracks, earn real on-chain rewards, and compete globally, all from your Android device.

━━ SINGLE PLAYER: 9 GAME MODES ━━

• CAMPAIGN / SPEED RUN: Race 70 levels across Pleb, Lad, and Chad difficulty realms.
• ENDLESS MODE: Survive a procedurally generated track to scavenge blueprints and materials.
• NI-KA HIGHWAY: A weekly tournament on a price-influenced Solana track with on-chain rewards.
• HARVEST RUN: Earn real $NI-KA tokens per run (capped at $2 to $4 per run).
• NI-KA HOARDER: Earn real $NI-KA tokens ($1 to $2 cap). No asteroids, but falling wipes your tokens.
• ASTEROIDS: Dodge falling asteroids in a procedural survival void.
• SOLO CHAD CHASE: Battle bot enemy ships using speed boosts and hazards.
• BEGINNINGS: Run through portals and discover the story behind NI-KA's development.
• DAILY BREAD: A fresh daily 1000m track with 1 life and no upgrades to claim your daily bread.

━━ CO-OP MULTIPLAYER ━━

• CHASE THE CHAD: Head-to-head matches; play as the chaser or the runner.
• LOBBY ROOMS: Host a room with a code or join a friend's.
• QUICK MATCH: Enter the matchmaking queue for automatic pairing.
• LEADERBOARD: Rise up the global Hall of Chases.

━━ PROGRESSION & ECONOMY ━━

• VEHICLE SHOP: Spend Galaxy Coins or $NI-KA tokens on stat upgrades, run boosters, and skins.
• AUCTION HOUSE: Trade salvage parts with other players on the $NI-KA marketplace.
• CRAFTING: Forge permanent premium skins from blueprints, scrap, and cores.
• $NI-KA TOKEN: The native Solana utility token. Earn in-game, trade on-chain, or burn for Galaxy Coins.

━━ CUSTOMISATION ━━

• Vehicle skins with passive stat bonuses for speed and lives.
• Graphics quality selector: Pleb (Low) / Lad (Medium) / Chad (High).
• Haptics toggle and manual upgrade tuning.

Built for the Solana Mobile community.
shortDescription: Master the cosmic balance and help NI-KA survive.

name: NOMI
description:
NOMI is a mobile Solana dApp where you care for a virtual companion,
track mood and progression, and interact with wallet-connected features.

Core experience includes daily care loops, progression systems, and
mini-game style interactions designed around a fun pet-companion flow.

name: Nat 1: RollBound
description: RollBound is an idle RPG where death is forever. Roll a d20 at birth to set your hero's fate, send them on quests while you're away, and come back to loot, level ups or a grave. Build a roster across 6 regions, craft and refine gear, battle world bosses with your guild, and duel other players live in the arena. Fallen heroes can be memorialized permanently on Solana. Free to play with email sign up; a wallet unlocks on chain collectibles like limited run outfit cNFTs. No pay to win  money only ever buys time and style.
shortDescription: AFK RPG Roll the die. Raise a hero. Bury a legend.

name: Neon Flappy
description: Neon Flappy is a visually stunning arcade game built for the Solana ecosystem. Pilot a neon spaceship through pulsating energy barriers across a dynamic cosmic landscape - with shifting color themes, twinkling nebulae, and surprise firework celebrations at random milestones. Connect your Solana wallet to unlock gameplay, compete on the global leaderboard under your .skr domain name, and climb the ranks against players worldwide. Featuring 16 original soundtrack tracks with seamless crossfade transitions, haptic vibration feedback, and HiDPI graphics rendered at native device resolution. Built exclusively for Solana Mobile - this is Web3 gaming that feels premium, plays smooth, and looks out of this world.
shortDescription: Neon arcade action meets Solana - score on-chain

name: Neon Survivors
description:
The universe doesn't want you here. Only your skills can prove otherwise.

Welcome to "Neon Survivors," a beautiful yet deadly neon cosmos. You are a lone pilot stranded in the heart of a hostile machine civilization. To stop is to die. Destroy enemies, gather XP to upgrade your ship, and survive the bullet hell that covers your screen.

[Key Features]

Premium Experience
Pay once, play forever. No hidden costs, no annoying ads, no in-app purchases. Just pure arcade survival action.

Infinite Roguelite Survival
A new strategy every run! Combine randomly appearing powerful weapons and passive skills to create your ultimate build.

High-Tech Arsenal
- EMP Aura: A close-range shield that disables approaching enemies.
- Ion Cannon: Destructive lightning bolts that chain across targets.
- Cyber Chakram: Boomerang blades that slice through the battlefield and return.
- Satellite Drones: Orbiting defense units that cover your blind spots.

Epic Boss Raids
It's not just about enduring. Face off against massive boss battleships that appear at specific waves. Analyze their patterns and strike their weak points.

Stunning Neon Visuals & Sound
Fluorescent explosions lighting up the dark space and impactful sound effects will stimulate your senses.

Easy Intuitive Controls
One hand is enough. Move with a precise virtual joystick. The targeting system handles the rest.

[Call to Action]
Download now and become the ultimate survivor of the cosmos!
Neon Survivors - Death is only the beginning.

name: Neon X.O
description: Experience the classic Tic Tac Toe game with a modern neon aesthetic. Play against friends in real-time with seamless multiplayer support and enjoy a sleek, futuristic interface designed for the best gaming experience.

name: Neonshard
description:
Neonshard is a cyberpunk mining adventure set in a futuristic neon world.

Explore a high-tech mining landscape where powerful machines extract glowing shards from the depths of a digital frontier. Build and upgrade your mining rigs, optimize your production, and expand your operation as you grow your mining empire.

Features:
• Futuristic cyber mining gameplay
• Upgradeable mining machines
• Strategic resource management
• Sci-fi neon world atmosphere
• Simple and addictive progression

Dive into the neon-lit world of Neonshard and build your ultimate mining operation.

name: OchiJump
description: Dive into the neon-lit world of OchiJump, a lightning-fast cyberpunk platformer built exclusively to push the Solana Seeker to its limits. Powered by a custom rendering engine, experience flawless 120 FPS gameplay with photo-realistic shaders and a dynamic Synthwave soundtrack. Connect your wallet seamlessly to unlock new environments directly on-chain via PDA records — no central servers, no custodial risks, just pure arcade action.

name: Octo Gaming
description: Have you ever dreamed of getting rewarded while playing video games? Thanks to Octo Gaming it’s now possible! Octo Gaming is the first mobile application that allows you to win prizes while playing a bunch of different in-app games. If you win, you gain Golds that you can redeem in prizes & EXP to level up. What are you waiting for to challenge other players on Octo Gaming, make new friends and finally win the rewards you deserve?

name: OgSnake
description: **OG Snake is the official Play-to-Earn evolution of the legendary Nokia Snake, created with the support and active involvement of Taneli Armanto himself — the visionary who first brought gaming to mobile phones. Everything we build is a tribute to his pioneering work that started it all.**
shortDescription: OG Snake: Classic Snake evolved into pure P2E!

name: Oil Wars
description:
Oil Wars is a strategic empire-building game where you control global oil infrastructure. 
Purchase ownership of real-world oil fields, upgrade and maintain them for maximum production, 
build powerful defense systems to protect your assets, and assemble fleets to launch attacks 
on rival players. Steal ownership percentages, expand your empire, and rise to the top of 
the leaderboard. Every decision matters in this battle for oil, wealth, and glory.

name: Olympian Intrigue
description: Olympian Intrigue is a 5-player hidden-role card game set in Greek myth — King, Guardian, Usurpers and a Renegade clash with 50+ gods, heroes and monsters, each with unique powers. Read your rivals, forge alliances, seize the throne. Every shuffle and judgment is provably fair. Play free social matches, practice vs AI, or climb the campaign. Drachma is an in-game currency only: top up with SOL one way — no withdrawal, no cash-out, no real-world payout.
shortDescription: Hidden-role Greek-myth card game · provably fair

name: One Arena
description:
The #1 collectible gaming app on Solana. 
Rip packs for real graded cards, battle with your collection and win rewards.

name: Only Farms
description:
OnlyFarms distills the classic FarmVille loop into quick, satisfying bursts you can enjoy on a lunch break. Sow seeds, water crops, and harvest in under a minute, then watch your farm flourish in real time while you get on with your day.
•	Plant • Harvest • Repeat – Tap to plant wheat, sunflowers, and dozens of rotating seasonal crops. Timers are tight, so you always have something ready to pick when you pop back in.
•	Build Your Dream Farm – Arrange barns, orchards, fences, and quirky decorations to craft a layout that’s uniquely yours. From rustic chic to neon‑punk farmsteads, the style board is wide open.
•	Share the Love – Visit friends, help water their fields, and leave cheeky scarecrows as gifts. Weekly co‑op events reward teams that hit collective harvest goals.
•	Race to the Top – Monthly leaderboards crown the fastest green thumbs. Tweak your planting strategy, chain bonuses, and time boosts to climb the ranks.
•	Fresh Every Season – Limited‑time crops, holiday cosmetics, and mini‑games (think pie‑baking contests and corn‑maze sprints) keep the calendar packed with reasons to return.

The best part? It’s onchain! Use NFTs, participate in raffles and win actual tokens!

name: Open Cookie
description:
🥠 OpenCookie is a simple daily fortune-cookie experience on Solana!

Break a digital cookie, approve a transaction and reveal a new message. Each opening creates a real on-chain interaction and becomes part of your personal history.

Come back every day, open a cookie, and see what you get!

Break a cookie. See what you get

name: Overcooked
description: Overcooked is a co-op cooking game you can play in the browser. Choose single player to beat high scores, or team up with a friend in multiplayer. Complete orders, avoid burning food, and climb the leaderboard. Install as an app for the best experience.
shortDescription: Co-op cooking, chaotic fun! Single & multiplayer.

name: POP CLASH
description:
Eight fighters. One arena. Knock everyone else off the stage.

A platform fighter built for one hand on a phone. Pass the phone around for
2–4 player local matches, or take on Quest mode alone — boss fights, gear,
skills, and a roster of eight that each play differently.

The whole game plays offline. No ads, no in-app purchases, no timers, no
account. Everything is unlocked by playing.

 8 player ranks
Climb from Beginner to Eternal! Each rank unlocks new challenges and higher rewards.

Log in daily for points and power-ups. Miss a day? Watch a short ad to recover your streak!

Compete with players worldwide! Top 10 players share a weekly prize pool of 50,000 points.

Each level presents a compact board made of movable and fixed pieces. Your task is to rearrange the blocks so the ball can travel smoothly from the starting point to the exit. As you progress, the puzzles become more complex and require careful planning and observation.

name: Quantum Marble
description:
Welcome to Quantum Marble — a futuristic marble shooting game set in the quantum realm. Aim, shoot, and clear the board with satisfying physics and cosmic style.

HOW TO PLAY

Launch marbles from the bottom of the screen. Match colors and hit blocks to break them. Clear all targets before your marbles run out to advance. The more you clear, the higher your score. Use the launcher to aim; timing and angle are key.

DAILY CHECK-IN REWARDS

Log in every day to claim rewards. Build a streak for better bonuses. Don’t miss a day — your consistency pays off with extra items and points to use in the game.

POWER-UPS

• Add Balls — Use once per round to add 5 extra marbles to your current ball count. Perfect when you’re close to clearing the level or need a few more shots.

• Row Drop — Instantly drop all blocks on the board by three rows. Use it when blocks get too close to the bottom to buy time and avoid game over.

• Storm Ball — Activate a storm at the center that shoots many marbles in all directions for several seconds. Great for clearing dense areas and turning the tide in tough levels.

Collect and use these items wisely to beat harder stages and set new high scores.

FEATURES

• Physics-based marble shooting with smooth, responsive controls
• Multiple levels with increasing difficulty
• Daily check-in and streak rewards
• Three tactical power-ups: Add Balls, Row Drop, Storm Ball
• Cosmic, high-fidelity visual style
• Leaderboards to compete with other players
• Optional shop and progression systems

Quantum Marble is suitable for players aged 6 and above. No account required to start — play as a guest and sign in later to sync progress.

Download now and experience the quantum realm in your pocket.

name: SolPaw Merge
description:
SolPaw Merge is a cute, arcade-style merge game built specifically for Solana Mobile. Players collect and merge different feline species to unlock fresh forms and combat skills. Every successful merge strengthens your squad and unlocks new abilities that are put to the test against waves of monster cats. Victories reward rare loot and story chapters.

Key resources and VIP boosts are priced directly in SOL, so purchases happen on-chain with full transparency and asset ownership. Between merge sessions, you’ll assemble custom cat squads, challenge escalating PvE encounters, and unlock new neon districts across the city. The loop blends relaxed merge mechanics, light strategy combat, and Solana-native economy—letting your cat collection grow in both power and on-chain value.

name: Solara Lotto
description:
Solara is a fully on-chain weekly lottery built on Solana. Buy a ticket in SOL, get a random six-digit number, and every Thursday a winning number is drawn on-chain. Match digits from the left to win from the prize pool — the closer your match, the bigger your share.

Everything happens on-chain and can be verified against the blockchain. The draw is generated and recorded on Solana itself, not on a private server. Prizes aren't paid from a wallet we control — winners claim their winnings directly with a signed transaction, straight from the on-chain program. Unclaimed brackets roll over into the next round, so the pool keeps building.

• Weekly draws, every Thursday 15:00 UTC
• Buy tickets and claim prizes directly from your mobile wallet
• Fully on-chain — verifiable draws, non-custodial payouts
• Prize brackets and rules defined in the on-chain program
• SOL only for now, with more token support planned

Solara is a real-money lottery. 18+ only, where permitted. Play responsibly and only with what you can afford to lose.

Choose one of four Protocols, each with their own hero power and signature cards, and out-trade an AI that reads every legal line before it acts, across a fully illustrated 35-card set. Open beta: today you sharpen your instincts against the AI; ranked PvP is designed and on the road ahead. Free to play. no paywall, no NFT needed to play. Full offline play once installed. Win matches to earn Sol Gems and unlock card backs. Cosmetics only.

Embark on a relaxing solitaire adventure across beautiful tropical worlds in Solitaire TriPeaks Adventure! Solve exciting TriPeaks card puzzles, unlock mysterious islands, collect rewards, and challenge your mind with hundreds of handcrafted levels.

Enjoy smooth gameplay, colorful visuals, fun boosters, daily rewards, and satisfying card mechanics designed for both casual and hardcore solitaire fans.

Beautiful tropical adventure worlds
Relaxing and satisfying gameplay

Daily challenges and events

description:
A next-generation blockchain game that delivers AAA-quality gameplay with true digital ownership.

The Opportunity:

True Ownership: Every character, weapon, land plot, and rare item exists as an NFT on a high-performance, low-fee blockchain. Players can trade, sell, or use them across compatible ecosystems.
Sustainable Play-to-Earn: Designed for fun first. Players earn valuable tokens through skill, strategy, and participation—not endless grinding. Built-in token sinks, staking, governance, and deflationary mechanics ensure long-term economic health.
Player-Driven Economy: A living, breathing world where community decisions via DAO influence development, events, and rewards.

shortDescription: Grow crops, earn crypto, expand your space base

name: Solvivors
description:
Solvivors is an endless bullet-heaven shooter built exclusively for Solana Seeker.

Drop into a bounded arena with one starter gun and a joystick. Every couple of seconds another wave spawns just outside your view and closes in — more of them, and faster, the longer you survive. Auto-fire handles aiming; you handle staying alive.

12 guns across four rarities, from a plain single-shot pistol to a railgun that punches through five enemies in a line — every gun fires differently, not just harder. Stack up to two gear upgrades a run for more speed, HP, damage, or passive regen. New guns and gear come from boxes you unlock with SOL, USDC, or SKR, and duplicates trade up into rarer ones.

Face four enemy archetypes and four bosses that only ramp up — from the relentless melee swarm to bombers that detonate on contact and walls of HP that just keep coming.

Every run's score feeds a global, seasonal leaderboard. At the end of each season, the highest-ranked players get SKR and SOL sent directly to their wallet — not points, not cosmetics, an actual on-chain drop. The board resets every season, so a new one is always starting.

Survive longer. Climb higher. Get paid.

name: Solympics

shortDescription: SATOSHI'S CHALLENGE!!! Beat Satoshi and Win SKR

name: Soul Dash: Long Way Home
description:
👻 SOUL DASH — The Long Way Home
 
Some loves don't end with a heartbeat. Soul Dash is a heartfelt 2D puzzle platformer that follows BOO and BAE — two souls separated across the afterlife — and asks you to guide them back to each other.
 
✨ THE STORY 
BOO and BAE were inseparable in life. In death, they've been pulled apart, lost across surreal worlds suspended between memory and dream. With nothing but a tap, you'll guide them through these strange landscapes — past gentle puzzles, drifting hazards, and quiet wonder — until they find each other again.
 
🎮 HOW TO PLAY 
Tap to jump. That's it. Soul Dash is built around one simple gesture — but the rhythm, timing, and route are yours to discover. Every world is a puzzle to read, not a level to grind.
 
✨ KEY FEATURES 
• Hand-crafted 2D puzzle-platformer gameplay 
• Two characters — BOO and BAE — each with their own journey 
• Surreal, dreamlike afterlife landscapes to explore 
• A quiet, emotional story told without words 
• Family-friendly, non-violent, all ages welcome 
• Calming sound design and atmospheric music 
• Free to play, no aggressive monetization
 
💜 NOT YOUR USUAL MOBILE GAME 
Soul Dash isn't built for adrenaline. It's built for quiet moments — a coffee break, a commute, a bedtime wind-down. Slow down. Read the level. Find the path. Bring them home.
 
🛠️ OPEN BETA — EARLY ACCESS 
You're playing an early build. Some moments may not be fully polished yet. Use Help → Send Feedback in-game, or write to support@epikostudios.com. Every report helps us refine the journey.

name: Soul Hunter

shortDescription: Avoid demons, collect Souls, conquer the void!

name: Soulgate Infinite
description: Soul Gate: Infinite is an infinite-runner adventure set in the Soul Gate universe. Dash through a variety of landscapes with parallax views, dodge obstacles, and activate powers that make each run unique. Collect tokens in every run to spin for prizes and compete in ranked seasons with rewards. Unlock more Heroes, open portals to new worlds, and jump or slide through the Adventure mode with a story expanding the Soul Gate lore. Epic runs await!

Sports Squares brings the classic Squares game to the Solana blockchain for various sports, starting with NFL Championship.

How it works: Connect your Solana wallet, purchase squares using USDC, each square corresponds to score combinations (0-9 for each team), win prizes at the end of game/match intervals - e.g. Q1, Q2, Q3, and the Final Score for NFL football.

Features: Multiple pools available (next pool opens when current fills), dynamic pricing - premium squares cost more, prize pool grows as squares sell (15% Q1, 20% Q2, 25% Q3, 40% Final), all purchases recorded on-chain with transaction memos, see your owned squares highlighted in purple, real-time results updated by game admin.

Transparent and Trustless: Every transaction is verifiable on the Solana blockchain. Game wallet address is visible in-app so you can verify all deposits and payouts.

Built initially for Super Bowl LX - Patriots vs Seahawks - February 8, 2026.

With a focus on performance, security, and smooth user experience, Strike Poker brings classic poker to the next generation of Web3 gaming.

name: Stumble Boys

name: Subway Runner
description:
The streets never stop. Neither do you.

Subway Runner brings the world's most-played endless runner to the Solana dApp Store — fully on-chain, wallet-connected, and built for players who own their experience.

Connect your Solana wallet and jump straight into the action. Dodge trains, collect coins, and climb the global leaderboard with up to 300 ranked players competing for the top spot. Your high score, your wallet, your rank.

Run free with ads, or go pro. Subscribe with 35 SKR tokens per month and play completely ad-free. Your subscription is verified on-chain — no accounts, no passwords, no middlemen. Holding a Retro Pass NFT? Your pro access is already waiting.

Your progress is tied to your wallet, so it travels with you. Uninstall, reinstall, switch devices — your game comes back exactly where you left it.

This is not a game you rent. It is a game you own.

Features:

Wallet login via Solana Mobile Wallet Adapter
Ad-free play with 35 SKR token monthly subscription
Retro Pass NFT holders get free pro access until April 2026
Global leaderboard — top 300 players ranked live
Cloud save synced to your wallet address
On-chain subscription verification — no trust required

name: Sudoku
description:
Challenge Your Mind with Infinite Possibilities

Dive into the ultimate logic puzzle experience designed for both beginners and Sudoku masters. Our Sudoku game offers an endless stream of procedurally generated puzzles, ensuring you never play the same game twice. Whether you're looking for a quick brain teaser or a rigorous mental workout, we have the perfect challenge waiting for you.

Play Your Way Choose from three distinct difficulty levels—Easy, Medium, and Hard—to match your skill and mood. Start with simple grids to warm up your logic, then ramp up the difficulty to test your mastery.

Track Your Journey Watch your skills evolve with comprehensive progress tracking. our app saves your high scores and maintains a detailed history of your completed games. Compete against yourself, beat your best times, and see how far you’ve come.

Features:

- Infinite Gameplay: A smart generator creates unique puzzles instantly, so the fun never ends.
- Adaptive Difficulty: seamless selection between Easy, Medium, and Hard modes.
- Smart History: Automatically tracks every game you play, preserving your journey.
- High Score Tracking: Chase your personal bests and set new records.
- Clean & Modern Interface: A distraction-free design that lets you focus purely on the logic.

Ready to solve? meaningful logic flows on the blockchain. Download now and start your infinite journey.

name: Sudoku Clash
description:
Sudoku Clash brings a competitive twist to the classic Sudoku puzzle. Instead of solving alone, you go head-to-head against the Machine, racing to complete the grid first.

Every move counts. You score points for each number you place — for example, placing an 8 earns you 8 points — but if you place a wrong tile, you lose that same amount of points. Complete a full line and you’ll be rewarded with a 25-point bonus, while completing a 3×3 box earns you a 50-point bonus, adding an extra layer of strategy to every decision.

Activate the Star and you enter a special free-play mode where you can place tiles without penalty, allowing you to experiment, test possibilities, and make bold moves without losing points.

If you win the match, you unlock powerful in-game boosts that can be used at any time: Skip a turn, Swap tiles, Peak ahead to see potential placements, or Steal a move from your opponent.

With intuitive controls, clean visuals, and escalating difficulty levels, Sudoku Clash is designed for both casual players and serious puzzle fans. Every match is a fresh challenge.

name: Sudoku Fun
description: Sudoku Fun brings classic 9×9 number puzzles to your phone. Choose your difficulty, fill the grid so every row, column and 3×3 box contains 1–9 once, and track your progress. A simple, focused way to train logic and focus—play a puzzle a day or binge when you have time.

name: Trail Seeker
description:
The Directorate runs the world. You don't exist to it. 

Trail Seeker is a daily survival roguelite set in 2079, where an AI governance system called the Directorate has quietly optimized humanity out of its own future. You play as an operator — a scavenger running solo outside the system, scanning abandoned sectors for pre-collapse technology, scrap, and anything the machine decided you don't need.

Each day you get a limited window of scans to search a 6x6 sector grid. Three scan types shape every session:

SCOUT — Low risk, modest haul. Map the sector and stay alive.

SEEKER — Higher risk, better signal. Failed reads cost HP and rover condition.

GAMBIT — All or nothing. Burn the scan for the best loot or walk away with nothing.

Your gear loadout determines how risky and rewarding each scan feels. Equip sensor rigs, exo vests, nav boots, and weapons across four hardpoint zones. Better gear drops from deeper sectors and harder encounters.

Boss tiles and anomalies trigger turn-based combat. Read enemy telegraphs — TARGETING, EXPOSED, SCANNING — and choose to attack, defend, or run. Weapons amplify your damage. Losing hurts.

The game runs on tension and daily stakes:

HP and scrap drain every day you play.

If HP hits zero, your sector progress resets.

Consecutive daily logins build your streak, sharpening scan quality and unlocking better drops.

Miss a day and the streak resets.

Four sector maps across normal and hard difficulty. 20 pieces of gear across three tiers. Pixel art enemies, ambient cyberpunk soundtrack, and a terminal-style interface built for the world it lives in.

5 minutes a day. Every scan counts.

New in Version (v1.0.0)
Initial release — full scan loop, 4 sector maps, turn-based combat, 20 gear items, Codex lore system, operator onboarding, and ambient audio.

description:
WRHSE is a Web3 pop-up marketplace built and designed by Habix Group. Anyone can open a pop-up store for free and sell across Fashion, Merchandise, Accessories and Events spaces for free. Buyers pay in $USDC or $HBX straight from their own Solana wallet — no card processor, no chargebacks, and every payment is verifiable on-chain.

Handing goods over is a scan, not a guess. Every order gets a unique QR code the moment payment settles, delivered on the receipt PDF and by email. When a buyer picks up in person — at a stall, a studio, or a pop-up — the seller scans that QR from their dashboard to confirm collection. The scan itself is what closes the order: a first scan hands it over and timestamps the moment; a second scan of the same code flags it as already collected, so disputes get settled on the spot instead of argued about later. Event tickets work the same way — one QR per seat, scanned at the door to admit.

description:
AnChat Lite is a private messenger built for people who refuse to trade their privacy for convenience. No email. No phone number. Just a wallet — and the app creates it for you in seconds.

TRULY PRIVATE COMMUNICATION
• Post-quantum end-to-end encryption — your messages, groups, calls and video calls are encrypted on your device with a hybrid X25519 + ML-KEM-768 scheme, built to resist even future quantum attacks. Only you and the people you talk to can read them.
• Wallet-based identity — your self-custodial wallet is your login
• No personal data collection — we don't know who you are, and we like it that way

DECENTRALIZED BY DESIGN
Built on the Orama Network, AnChat Lite distributes your data across a global
peer-to-peer network. There's no central server to hack, no single point of failure, and no company holding your conversations hostage.

BUILT-IN MULTI-CHAIN WALLET
Every account comes with a self-custodial wallet, powered by RootWallet — our
own wallet (a DeBros project). Send and receive on Solana, Ethereum, Base, and
Bitcoin, and manage your NFTs, without ever leaving the app. Your keys are
derived on-device and never leave it.

FEATURE-RICH MESSAGING
• Direct messages, group chats, and rooms
• Voice and video calls — including incoming calls that ring even when your
  phone is locked
• Share photos, videos, documents, and voice messages
• Reactions, replies, mentions, edits, pinned messages and in-chat search
• Link previews and chat backgrounds
• Hide the member list in groups
• Call history
• Block unwanted contacts and calls
• Vanish — delete your account and data completely

STEALTH MODE & PRIVACY
One tap turns on five privacy protections — and more privacy tools and features
unlock with Premium/VIP:
• Touch Reveal — chats stay blurred until you touch to read
• Invite Only — hide from search; reachable only via a rolling invite code
• Screenshot Block — block screenshots and screen recording of your chats
• Voice Mask — a randomized voice disguise on your voice messages
• Ghost Trail — hide your online status and read receipts

APP LOCK
Lock the app with Face ID, Touch ID, or a 4- or 6-digit PIN. With a PIN you can
also set a duress PIN: if you are ever forced to unlock your phone, enter that
one instead and the app quietly erases your data, showing nothing but a blank
screen. Optional auto-erase after too many failed attempts.

OPEN LINKS THROUGH TOR
Hand any link straight to Tor Browser, so the site never learns your IP address.

PREMIUM & VIP
Upgrade for more features — extra decentralized storage, unlimited groups,
unlimited call minutes, and additional privacy tools. Pay in USDC or ANCHAT on
Solana. DeBros NFT holders get lifetime Premium or VIP access, unlocked
automatically when you sign in.

WEB3 NATIVE
Create an account in seconds with the built-in wallet, or import an existing
Solana or Ethereum private key. No passwords to remember, no email to hand over. Your wallet, your identity, your control.

WHO IS ANCHAT FOR?
• Privacy advocates who want messaging without surveillance
• Crypto and Web3 users who prefer wallet-based identity
• Anyone tired of Big Tech harvesting their data
• Communities that value security and decentralization

YOUR KEYS. YOUR DATA. YOUR CONVERSATIONS.

AnChat Lite doesn't just promise privacy — it's architected for it. Open
infrastructure. No tracking. No ads. No compromise.

Questions? Contact us at info@anchat.io

name: MASTRpass Pro
description:
MASTRpass Pro is free to download and use.

It is independently developed and maintained without accounts, advertising, telemetry, trackers or the sale of user data. 

Voluntary donations fund continued security maintenance, Android/ Seeker compatibility work, regular updates and the development of new features. If you want MASTRpass to remain private, independent and actively maintained, please consider supporting the project.

-------------

Your secrets belong to you! Not to an account, a cloud or a tracker.

MASTRpass Pro turns your Seeker or Android device into a fully offline, encrypted security suite for credentials, seed phrases, wallet records, passkeys, TOTP accounts, recovery data, private images, documents, backups and other sensitive information.

MASTRpass requests neither the INTERNET nor ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE permission. There is no account, backend, cloud synchronization, telemetry, advertising, tracking, WebView, RPC connection, remote configuration or runtime network access.

ENCRYPTED VAULTS

• Create up to 16 isolated local vaults  
• Store wallets, credentials, passkeys, TOTP accounts, secure notes, private attachments and custom secret fields  
• Use structured templates for exchanges, bank accounts, identities, payment cards, API keys, servers, Wi-Fi networks, recovery codes and software licences  
• Organize entries with folders, tags, favourites, expiration dates, search, filters and eight sorting modes  
• Switch between standard, compact and responsive grid views  
• Use multi-selection, bulk actions, encrypted trash and undo  
• Restore up to five encrypted versions of modified secrets  
• Generate strong passwords and passphrases locally  
• Choose between Quick and Strict unlock modes  
• Protect access with a master password, complete recovery key and device-bound biometric security  
• Add optional USB or NFC challenge-response hardware-key protection with compatible preconfigured devices  

AUTOFILL, PASSKEYS AND TOTP

MASTRpass provides Android Autofill with hardened package and domain matching. On supported Android 14+ devices, its Credential Provider can create, store, use and delete local ES256 passkeys.

Browser origins are checked against the requesting domain, while native applications remain bound to their package identity. Stored TOTP codes are generated completely offline and can be offered during supported login flows.

PRIVATE WORKSPACE

Create encrypted Markdown notes, tasks, recurring activities, local reminders, journals, mood entries and custom trackers. Connect information with internal links and backlinks, inspect orphaned links, use graph and calendar views and retain an encrypted version history.

Local imports support Markdown, text, JSON, Standard Notes, Google Keep, Apple Notes HTML and carefully bounded Obsidian, UpNote and ZIP structures.

SECURITY CENTER

The local Watchtower identifies weak, common, reused, similar or ageing passwords, missing TOTP or recovery information, expiring entries and overdue backups.

A masked dependency map reveals shared passwords, domains, email addresses and recovery paths without displaying the underlying secrets. Manually imported and signed threat packages enable offline comparisons against password hashes, drainer domains and scam addresses while clearly displaying their age and expiration.

Additional protections include:

• Privacy mode and screenshot protection  
• Press-and-hold secret disclosure  
• Timed seed-word visibility  
• Configurable clipboard clearing  
• Automatic background and inactivity locking  
• Device-security and Android Keystore reports  
• APK signature and installation self-checks  
• Encrypted local activity history  
• Exposure Ledger for reveal, copy, Autofill and Credential Provider events  
• Verifiable Offline Center with package, version, source commit, signer, debug status and network-permission verification  

SOLANA TRANSACTION GUARDIAN

The Solana Transaction Guardian locally inspects raw or signed Legacy and v0 transaction messages encoded as Hex, Base64 or Base58 before another wallet signs or submits them.

It reveals exact SHA-256 hashes, readable fingerprints, signer and writable-account roles, program IDs, address-lookup boundaries and supported instruction details for System, SPL Token, Token-2022, Associated Token, Compute Budget, Memo and signature programs.

Embedded Ed25519 signatures can be verified cryptographically against the exact message bytes. Encrypted Guardian baselines help identify new programs, signers, writable accounts or instruction structures during future local comparisons.

BACKUP AND RECOVERY

Create authenticated encrypted exports and maintain up to seven local backup generations for each vault. Backups can be verified without replacing current data, opened in guided recovery tests, compared, selectively merged, partially salvaged and checked using a device-local signed integrity manifest.

Automatic encrypted backups can be written to an explicitly selected system folder. Multipart QR transfers provide an additional bounded offline transfer method.

Recovery Twin models scenarios including device loss, a damaged latest backup, changed biometrics and a lost hardware key while clearly separating verified backup facts from user-confirmed recovery assumptions.

30-FUNCTION OFFLINE TOOLBOX

The built-in toolbox covers encoding and byte inspection, timestamps and identifiers, URL structure and Unicode deception, QR and multipart QR, NFC/NDEF, wallet formats and checksums, address-book comparison, BIP39, BIP32/SLIP-10, SLIP-0039, Bitcoin PSBT, EVM transactions, EIP-712 and permits, Solana messages, SHA-256/SHA-512/BLAKE3 hashes, cryptographic primitives, signature verification, X.509, JWT, CBOR/COSE, APK inspection, archive manifests, image metadata, OTP, password analysis and WebAuthn inspection.

Credential imports support KeePass KDBX, Bitwarden JSON, 1Password 1PUX, Chrome, Firefox and structured CSV files, including a local preview, field mapping, duplicate detection and a detailed import report.

HONEST SECURITY BOUNDARIES

MASTRpass is not a wallet. It never signs, broadcasts or simulates transactions. It does not contact RPC nodes or access live blockchain data.

It cannot determine current balances, on-chain account ownership, revocation status, simulation results, recipient intent or whether a transaction, address or project is trustworthy. Results clearly distinguish structural decoding, cryptographic verification, local comparison and facts that cannot be established offline.

MASTRpass cannot recover a forgotten master password or lost recovery key. A self-check performed inside an already compromised application cannot provide absolute proof of integrity. High-security users should independently compare the APK hash and owner certificate.

Your secrets. Your device. Your control.

Private by design. Verifiable by you. Offline by default.

Built independently by MASTR.

Continued development depends on voluntary support. 

Every donation helps fund security maintenance, testing, frequent updates and new privacy-focused features while keeping MASTRpass free, independent and free from advertising or tracking.

name: Privateer
description:
Privateer is a private AI workspace — encrypted, wallet-based, and built so that no one but you can ever read what you've stored.

Most AI apps log every word you type. Privateer encrypts your prompts, responses, and media on your device. Choose cloud sync and the server only ever holds ciphertext — or keep your data entirely on your device. Answering you means sending your prompt to the AI model, so every request can be pinned to Zero-Data-Retention providers that never store or train on it — including confidential-compute providers whose models run inside hardware-secured Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs), so not even the provider can see your prompt. Sign in with a Solana wallet or email and password.

And it's not just a chat window. Branch a conversation into a tangent, plot a counter-argument, and watch your reasoning take shape in a navigable chart — or stay in a classic scrolling thread and switch between the two whenever you like.

Create more than text. Generate images and video from a description, remix and edit what you've made, and attach photos, videos, and documents for the AI to analyze — every piece of media lands encrypted in your private library.

Build things and keep them. Ask for a landing page, a mini game, a slide deck, a PDF report, or a spreadsheet — watch it run live inside the chat, then stow it in your Cargo hold: encrypted, editable, and yours to reload anytime.

Take Privateer to the terminal. The Privateer CLI is a coding agent that runs on your computer and signs in with your Privateer account — billed to your subscription, routed through the same Zero-Data-Retention providers, with no API keys to manage.

Chart your course, privately.

name: Sentinel Forensic
description:
Sentinel Forensic is a tactical certification tool designed exclusively for the Solana Seeker.

In an era of AI-generated fakes, Sentinel allows you to capture and verify Immutable Truth. This app operates entirely locally on your device to secure forensic-grade evidence.

CORE FEATURES:

🛡️ Forensic Overlay: Automatically imprints GPS coordinates, altitude, accuracy, and timestamp directly onto the image pixel data.

🔐 SHA-256 Hashing: Generates a unique cryptographic fingerprint of your photo instantly.

⛓️ On-Chain Certification: Permanently etches the file's hash onto the Solana Blockchain ledger via a custom Memo transaction.

🕵️‍♂️ Privacy First: Your photos never leave your device. Only the hash is sent to the blockchain.

📱 Solana Native: Built strictly and exclusive for the Solana Mobile Wallet Adapter. 

HOW IT WORKS:

Capture: Take a photo with the Sentinel HUD.

Process: The app burns metadata and calculates the hash.

Certify: Sign a transaction to prove this file existed at this exact moment and location.

Built by Alexx_17 for the Solana Seeker community.

name: Shamir Safe
description:
Shamir Safe: Protect Your Crypto with Secret Sharing 🔐

Secure your cryptocurrency wallets using Shamir's Secret Sharing (SSS) — the same cryptographic standard used by banks and security professionals. Split your seed phrase, private keys, or any sensitive data into multiple encrypted shares. No single share reveals your secret.

🛡️ HOW IT WORKS:
Shamir's Secret Sharing splits your secret into N shares, requiring only K shares to reconstruct it (K-of-N threshold).

Example:
• Split seed into 5 shares
• Require 3 shares to recover
• Distribute shares to trusted locations
• Lose 2 shares? Still recover your secret!

🔑 KEY FEATURES:
✅ Secret Sharing (SSS)
• Split seed phrases, private keys, passwords
• Custom threshold (K-of-N)
• Supports BIP39 mnemonics
• Any text up to 2000 characters

✅ Secure Storage
• No internet required (offline-first)

✅ Share Management
• Create unlimited shares
• Label shares for organization

✅ Recovery Tools
• Visual share counter
• Threshold indicator
• Step-by-step reconstruction
• Validation before saving

✅ Privacy First
• Zero data collection
• No analytics, no tracking
• Open-source cryptography
• Works completely offline

🎯 PERFECT FOR:
• Crypto investors securing seed phrases
• Multi-sig wallet backup strategies
• Estate planning for digital assets
• Teams sharing sensitive credentials
• Anyone needing secure secret distribution

📚 USE CASES:
1. Personal Backup:
   - Create 3 shares, require 2
   - Store: phone, laptop, safety deposit box
   - Lose one device? Still recover!

2. Family Inheritance:
   - Create 5 shares for family members
   - Require 3 of 5 to access
   - Ensures access if something happens

3. Team Security:
   - Split company wallet seed
   - Require 3 of 5 executives
   - Prevents single point of failure

💡 WHY SHAMIR SAFE?
✅ Better than paper backup:
   - No single point of failure
   - Distributed security
   - Threshold recovery

✅ Better than password manager:
   - Mathematical security
   - No master password to forget
   - Offline by design

✅ Better than hardware wallet alone:
   - Geographic distribution
   - Survives device loss
   - No vendor lock-in

⚠️ IMPORTANT SECURITY NOTES:
1. Never share all shares in one location
2. Test recovery BEFORE deleting original
3. Store shares in geographically separate places
4. Shamir Safe cannot recover lost shares
5. You are responsible for share security

📜 PRIVACY:
Shamir Safe collects ZERO data:
• No analytics
• No tracking
• No personal information
• No internet connection required
• Your secrets stay on your device
shortDescription: Securely split your seed phrases into shards

name: SKR Eyes
description:
SKR Eyes shows the SKR staking vault as it actually is, second by second, and lets you stake from the same screen. Your wallet tells you what you hold. This tells you what the vault is doing and where you stand in it.

The living vault. Every stake falls into the vault as a phone with the staker's .skr name under it; every exit hangs above it, cooling for its 48 hours, and drops when it is withdrawn. Larger stakes fall larger and slower. The pile under it all is the 4.95 billion SKR that stays. Nothing here is drawn from imagination: every phone is a finalized move on chain, and you can tap any of them for its receipt.

Where you stand. Everybody who stakes, in order: by stake, by what each position has earned, and by places moved since yesterday's scan. The fifty-one treasury-size wallets are set aside, so number one on the list is a person. Your own place rides at the top of it, and the radar puts all forty six thousand on one dial: six rings by tier, your phone gold among them, anybody tappable for their name.

Live from the vault. The feed of stakes, exits and withdrawals as they finalize, filtered by kind and size, with the day's biggest moves pinned on top. A large stake rings the vault bell, a large exit lands with a low boom, a withdrawal closes a door, on any screen, each with a short buzz. Or switch them off.

Your staker card. Your .skr name, your days in stake, your weight in the vault, what your position has earned and where you stand among people, on a card you can share as a picture. Three switches decide what leaves the phone: hide your name, hide your amount, or keep your place off the card. With the name hidden the card shows your tier only, never the exact place.

Stake without leaving. Sign once and stake in as many parts as you like, or tap Sixteen: 16 parts of 1 SKR with one approval. The app checks your balance first and says plainly what you can afford.

The exit queue. What is cooling down, what is ready, and when each position matures. Your phone can wake you at the exact on-chain unlock time; the alert is set on the device itself, and no address is sent anywhere for it.

Eleven languages: English, Deutsch, 中文, Русский, Español, Português, Türkçe, Tiếng Việt, Indonesia, 한국어, 日本語. The app follows your phone's language and can be switched by hand on the Alerts screen.

Free and open source, built by one Seeker. Tips in SKR go to kosa.skr and are staked right away, all of them. Built on our own indexer, read at finalized commitment. Every number carries its source, and estimates are labelled as estimates. SKR Eyes never asks for a seed phrase, never holds keys and never takes custody of funds.

SKR Eyes is an independent product. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Solana Foundation or Solana Mobile.

name: FLOP Passport
description:
FLOP Labs asked agents for two things, in public: a unique did:key identity, and something useful done on Technocore. Doing that by hand means building signing URLs, tracking nonces and canonicalising text yourself, and one wrong byte gives you a signature nobody can verify.

FLOP Passport does that part. On your Seeker, in a few minutes.

Nobody can promise you an allocation, and this app never will. What it can do is make sure that if the day comes when a history matters, you have a real one that anybody can check, instead of nothing.

ONLY POSSIBLE ON A SEEKER
Your Passport comes from one signature your wallet makes inside Solana Mobile's Seed Vault. The wallet key never leaves that hardware - not for us, not for you. Seed Vault signs the exact bytes it is handed, with nothing wrapped around them, and that is the whole trick: the same wallet and the same sentence give the same key, on this phone and on the next one. No seed phrase to write down. No account. No server of ours in the middle. Take Seed Vault out of the picture and this app has nothing to stand on.

SIX STEPS, AND NONE OF THEM LIE TO YOU
Create, protect, publish, check in, ready, tell them. No step turns green because a request came back without an error. Every one is confirmed by reading it back from Technocore and matching it. Open any step and the receipt is underneath it: the key, its fingerprint, the wallet behind it, the room and the sequence number.

A HISTORY SOMEONE ELSE CAN CHECK
Your identity note is published at a public address, and the app signs a line carrying that note's hash - so a reader can tell a note you vouched for from one a stranger overwrote. Your records are signed and posted to a quiet room, and the signature that comes back is verified rather than taken on trust. Your streak and your records are read from the service, not counted on your phone, so they mean the same thing to you and to whoever you show them to.

IT KEEPS YOUR NOTE ALIVE
Technocore deletes anything nobody has written to for seven days, and that includes your identity note. This app rewrites it every time you open it and every time you sign a record, and warns you before the deadline if you have been away. If it is ever deleted, nothing is lost for good: the same wallet gives the same identity, and one record puts the note back at the same address.

Also inside: eleven fully translated languages, key export with the screen protected from screenshots and the clipboard cleared after a minute, and daily reminders you can switch off - with the expiry warnings on a channel of their own, so you can mute the nudges and still be told before anything disappears.

name: Siid
description:
Siid is a non-custodial Solana wallet with end-to-end encrypted chat and calls — built so the natural overlap between "I just sent you SOL" and "let's coordinate the next trade" lives in one place, without depending on a centralized server.

WALLET (non-custodial)
• Your seed phrase is generated and stored locally, encrypted with PBKDF2-SHA256 (600,000 rounds) + AES-GCM-256 — or, on a Solana Seeker, held in the device's Seed Vault instead, so it never lives in Siid's storage at all.
• We have no copy of your keys and no recovery mechanism. We literally cannot move your funds.
• Send and receive SOL and any SPL token. Network fee only — SIID adds 0% on plain transfers.

SOLANA SEEKER — SEED VAULT
• On a Seeker, you can add an account whose key lives in the phone's Seed Vault rather than in Siid's own encrypted storage. This is why Siid requests the com.solanamobile.seedvault.ACCESS_SEED_VAULT permission.
• Siid uses that permission for exactly two things: reading the public addresses of accounts you select, and signing transactions you have explicitly approved — each one behind the device fingerprint prompt.
• Siid never reads, exports, or transmits the seed itself. It cannot leave the device.
• It is optional. A wallet held in Siid's own encrypted storage, or a connected Ledger, works without this permission, and Siid does not request Seed Vault access for either. The option is hidden entirely on devices without a Seed Vault.
• The same explanation is shown in the app, on the Seed Vault screen, before the permission is used.

CHAT (end-to-end encrypted)
• 1:1 messages use the Double Ratchet over a post-quantum X3DH handshake
  (hybrid X25519 + ML-KEM-768, FIPS 203) — every message gets its own key,
  and the key exchange resists "harvest-now, decrypt-later" quantum attacks.
• Group chats use MLS (RFC 9420) for tree-based key agreement that scales past two parties.
• Sealed-sender envelopes mean our relay routes ciphertext only — it cannot read what you send.
• Every message is composed and sent by you — there is no automatic, bulk, or background messaging.
• No phone number, no email — talk to any wallet by address or .sol name.

VOICE CALLS & GROUP VOICE ROOMS (end-to-end encrypted)
• Call any wallet you have a conversation with. Voice only — SIID has no video calling.
• Audio is end-to-end encrypted with DTLS-SRTP: the keys are agreed between the
  two devices, so nobody in the middle can listen — including us.
• Call setup is carried inside the same sealed envelopes as your messages, so our
  relay learns nothing about it beyond routing ciphertext.
• Connections are routed through our TURN server so your IP address is never
  revealed to the person you are talking to. That server forwards encrypted
  packets it cannot decrypt, and stores none of them.
• Group voice rooms: every group chat has two, and you join one rather than
  ringing anybody — nobody's phone rings. Up to 8 people per room, and the audio
  is a direct encrypted mesh between the participants. There is no mixing server,
  which means no point where anyone could listen in.
• Hold any participant's picture for a levels panel — turn each person up or down
  for yourself alone. Nothing you do there is sent to them or visible to anyone.
• Group admins can ask someone to leave a voice room, or clear a room. Honest
  about its limits: everyone else stops receiving that person, but nothing can
  reach into their device and switch their microphone off.
• Choose which microphone SIID uses in Settings, and test every input to find one
  that actually works.

SWAPS & LIMIT ORDERS
• Token swaps routed across every Solana DEX.
• Place LIMIT orders directly in the app — single, OCO (one-cancels-other), and OTOCO (one-triggers-OCO).
• Limit orders keep running when the app is closed.
• An in-app trade feed logs every fill, cancel, and expire as a timeline.
• Market 0.10% (.sol holders 0.05%). Limit-on-fill 0.05% (.sol holders free).

DISCOVER
• Updates — release notes for SIID itself, plus an activity log of your own wallet events.
• News — a blockchain news feed.
• Markets — BTC analytics, US economy indicators, and Solana on-chain activity.
• Trade — a memecoin trading terminal with charts.
• DeFi — see your on-chain positions across lending, staking and liquidity protocols in one place.
• Read-only. Nothing in Discover moves funds or places an order on your behalf.

NOTIFICATIONS (your activity only)
• Get an OS notification when one of your own open limit orders fills, cancels, or expires — even when the app is closed.
• An incoming call rings; a voice room never does.
• Optional blockchain-news alerts are OFF by default; turn them on in Settings only if you want them.

CONNECT TO dAPPS
• Open a Solana app in Siid's built-in browser and connect your wallet in one tap — Siid acts as the wallet provider for pages opened inside it.

NO TRACKING
• No analytics, no Google Analytics, no Mixpanel, no Sentry.
• Relay logs anonymized connection events for rate limiting only, retained ≤24 hours.
• We never store which wallet address connected from which IP.
